627 (episode).plot:
[[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Gantu]] and [[Reuben (625)|625]] are in pursuit of [[Deforestator (515)|Experiment 515]]: the deforestator. The chase leads into town where 515 shreds everything in sight. Stitch corners him in an alley, defeats him, and rehabilitates him in record time. Gantu catches up to capture 515, but then retreats after 515 shreds his clothes along with 625's fur, leaving him in his underwear. Afterwards, both Lilo and Jumba complement on Stitch's performance in catching [[experiments]], which eventually gets to his head and becomes egotistical. When he behaves rudely at dinner and covers Jumba in cranberry sauce, he decides to teach him a lesson by creating a new experiment: [[627]]. More powerful than Stitch with none of his weaknesses, has twenty different powers of other Experiments and cannot be turned to good.

When [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] discovers what Jumba has done, knowing that 627 is an incredibly bad idea, he tries to go and tell Lilo, only for Jumba to threaten him to be quiet, otherwise he would create another Experiment with a giant finger that can poke out Pleakley's giant eye. At the same time, 627 escapes from containment and runs off into the forest. Meanwhile, after getting wrapped up in another argument over their recent failure to capture an Experiment, 625 goes out into the woods to have a sandwich. There he meets 627 and gives him to Gantu as his new sidekick, so he can stay at home and do nothing like he always does. Gantu is impressed with 627, especially when he demonstrates his ability to shoot plasma at 625.

The next day, Lilo and Stitch are at a farmyard where they are about to capture [[Zap (603)|Experiment 603]]: a living laser bolt. Stitch is still being egotistical, even while he successfully captures 603. Just then Gantu shows up with 627, and takes 603 from them. Stitch challenges 627 and easily gets beaten. They return [[Lilo's House|home]] with news of their encounter to Jumba and Pleakley. While looking through [[Jumba's Computer]] to determine which Experiment it was, Jumba accidentally confesses to 627's creation, causing Lilo to angrily lash out at him, and Pleakley gives Jumba an "I told you so." Stitch refuses to accept that 627 is more superior than him, and over the next few days he competes against his newest "cousin" in hunting Experiments. 627 successfully captures many experiments and Stitch ends up getting relentlessly bullied and tormented by him. After a while, Stitch admits defeat.

Meanwhile, things for 625 are no better. Since 627 became Gantu's new sidekick, he has been abused and forced to clean around the ship. Gantu has also decided to use 627 to conquer the galaxy by himself, even quitting his job of working for [[Dr. Hämsterviel]]. When 625 gets blast by 627 and slips, he discovers his weakness is laughter when he laughs uncontrollable over his misfortunes. Because he has had enough of 627's abuse, he calls Lilo and informs her of what he has discovered. Jumba clarifies that he gave 627 extra everything, including an extra large sense of humor. With 625's help, Lilo and Stitch lure Gantu and 627 to the middle of town for a final battle. Stitch defeats 627 by making a fool of himself during their battle and using the latter's abnormally large sense of humor against him. Eventually, 627 laughs himself into unconsciousness, and since he cannot be turned to good Lilo dehydrates him back into a [[Experiment Pods|pod]] using a home food dehydrator she ordered from a TV commercial earlier.

Afterwards, Stitch has learned his lesson and is no longer egotistical. Meanwhile, however, Jumba is shown to have made an Experiment 628 and stores the pod away on [[Jumba's Ship|his ship]].

A Stinky Episode.plot: Pleakley's parents bring Mr. Stenchy to the island when they come to visit. It causes a really bad aroma on the island and Stitch gets jealous once again.

Ace (episode).plot:
[[Mortlegax|The leader of the Evil Genius Organization]] (E.G.O.) believes that [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] has turned good and wants to revoke his membership, but [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] convince him to visit Earth so they can prove to him that Jumba is still worthy of membership. As they construct an elaborate facade to trick him, however, [[Ace (262)|a failed non-evil experiment]] is activated. Meanwhile, [[Reuben (625)|625]] and [[Gantu]] are playing go fish when they hear about this experiment. After learning that said experiment has no evil traits, they conclude that [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] would have no use for it, so they continue their card game.
<!--Further plot details go here. At the end of the episode, Lilo forms the Association of Alien Rejects, Reformed Geniuses, and Girls from Hawaii, or "AARRGGH".-->

Amnesio (episode).plot: It is [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]]'s birthday, but no one seems to remember. While she and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] hand out invitations for their own party, they encounter [[Gantu]] as well as [[Amnesio (303)|an experiment that gives people amnesia]]. All three of them try to catch Amnesio, which causes them to lose their memories of each other. Now thinking that her name is Martha, Stitch is an escaped criminal, and Gantu is her partner cop named Lenny, Lilo teams up with him to hunt down Stitch and find clues to their lost memories.

Angel (episode).plot:
One morning at [[Lilo's House|Lilo's house]], [[Pleakley]] is watching TV. He is interrupted by Lilo dumping some slugs from a jar onto the coffee table. When asked why, she explains that she and Stitch are making a slug circus. Pleakley goes back to his show, "America's Gushiest Home Love Stories", a show that broadcasts homemade documentaries of earthlings' absurd and over-the-top courtship rituals. He finds the concept of human courtship fascinating. [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] is disgusted with the idea of romance, but [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] disagrees, saying, "You gotta believe in love." Pleakley adds that Stitch may fall in love one day. Stitch doubts it, but before they can discuss it further, Lilo brings Stitch outside to get supplies for the slug circus. 

Out in town, the pair does some window shopping, but notices [[Gantu]] on the hunt. They figure an experiment is loose, and decide to split up and find it. But, when Lilo runs around the corner, she collides with the experiment; [[Angel (624)|she looks similar to Stitch, but has pink fur and long antennae]]. The experiment growls at Lilo, then runs off. Lilo yells at her, which alerts Stitch. Stitch grabs a nearby big wheel tricycle and speeds after the experiment. Lilo dumps a display case full of coconuts on the ground, which the pursuing Gantu slips on. He lands on top of a tour bus, and gets taken away...but only just out of Lilo's eyesight. He declares everything is going to plan.

Meanwhile, Stitch catches up with the experiment and corners her in an alley. She flirtatiously greets him, and Stitch gets nervous. Lilo catches up to them, and tells Stitch to grab her. Stitch refuses, calling the pink experiment "boojiboo." She licks his face in response. Lilo is not convinced that the experiment is as sweet as she presents herself, but they bring her home regardless.

Stitch and the experiment, now named "Angel," sit in the hammock in the backyard together. They briefly bond over picking their noses with their tongues. Their moment is interrupted by Pleakley, dressed as a movie director, shoving an old video camera in their faces and giving them stage directions. Lilo walks up and asks what is going on. Pleakley explains that he's filming Stitch and Angel's interactions to send to "America's Gushiest Home Love Stories." Lilo points out that he won't get much footage on his antique, filmless camera. Lilo suggests she and Pleakley talk to [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] to borrow his camera, as well as find out Angel's primary function.

Jumba offers Pleakley his state of the art digital camera, and Pleakley eagerly heads off to film some more. Lilo searches for Angel on Jumba's computer, and finds her number: 624. Hearing that, Jumba starts to panic. Before he can explain what her function is, Angel enters the room with Stitch. Angel jumps into Jumba's arms, kisses him on the cheek, then sings a song to him in [[Tantalog language|Tantalog]]. Jumba instantly calms down and says that Angel's function is to pop popcorn for movie night. He decides that Angel's one true place aside from that is to be with Stitch. Stitch runs to Angel to hug her, but Lilo stops him and drags him away, saying she still needs his help with her slug circus. After they leave, Jumba allows Angel to use his computer and search for active, rehabilitated experiments. He reveals Angel's function: to turn experiments (as well as himself) from good to evil.

Later, it's nearly bedtime. Lilo, still not trusting Angel, has set up a place for her to sleep in the laundry room. Angel doesn't mind, because this allows her to sneak out of the house, and make her way to Gantu's ship. [[Reuben (625)|625]] flirts with her upon seeing her, but wonders why she is there. Gantu explains that the entire day's events were all a part of his plan. He allowed Angel to be taken by Lilo and Stitch so she could access their experiment files. Angel will then find the good experiments and make them evil again.

The following morning, Stitch wakes Angel up and presents her with flowers. Angel sings to him, but Stitch remains as nice as before, complimenting her voice. Angel is confused that her song didn't work, but smiles at the gesture. Lilo, meanwhile, is working on her slug circus with little success. Angel leaves through the front door, with Stitch following closely behind. Pleakley follows after them both with his camera, wanting to document their "first conflict". Lilo is left alone and sad.

Angel goes to town, and hops up to [[Slushy (523)|Slushy]]'s shave ice stand. She sings to him, and he throws his cones away. Stitch and Pleakley arrive, but Slushy causes a small snowdrift on the street, freezing them both. Later, at the beach, Stitch tries making a sand sculpture of Angel. Angel doesn't see it, because she is paying attention to [[Richter (513)|Richter]], now causing tremors. Angel leaves, then makes her way to an an outdoor fitness center, where [[Kixx (601)|Kixx]] is. Stitch follows, and sees that other patrons have been beaten up. He notices Angel is feeling Kixx's muscles, and gets angry. He attacks Kixx and sends him flying and landing on top of Pleakley. For the rest of the day, Angel runs around the town, turning experiments evil. Stitch follows, and Pleakley films the whole thing. Eventually, in the early evening, Angel runs up Mount Waialeale. Stitch goes to follow her, but pauses upon hearing Pleakley's "commentary." He roars at him and Pleakley decides to head home. Stitch continues to follow Angel up the mountain.

At the house, Lilo is still depressed and missing Stitch. She heads to the living room, where Pleakley is watching his footage. Lilo takes a look as well, but notices something, then asks Pleakley to rewind and zoom in on Angel. She is wearing a collar with a long phone number on it. Lilo calls the number, but is shocked to hear Hämsterviel's voice on the other line. Lilo hangs up and runs to Jumba's room to tell him, but sees Jumba conducting experiments. Jumba admits that Angel ''is'' evil, and has restored his evil genius ways.

Meanwhile, Stitch gets to the top of the mountain. He does not see Angel, but hears her singing again. He follows the song into a burrow, which leads to a room within a spaceship. Inside the room are glass pods, where previously good experiments are being held. 625 is also there, and tells Stitch he made a bad decision coming to the location. Angel presses a button on the wall, closing the door to the outside. Gantu then enters, and tells Stitch that their "host" will explain what is going on. A monitor drops from the ceiling, and [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] appears onscreen. He gloats over his successful plan of converting the experiments to evil, and thanks Angel for her help. He adds that they will all wreak havoc on the Galactic Empire. Stitch is horrified to hear this.

At home, Lilo asks Jumba if there is a way to reverse the effects of Angel's song. Jumba says that since he is evil, he isn't telling. Lilo then notices he left his computer unattended and makes a grab for it. Jumba tries grabbing Lilo, but manages to jump out of the room entirely. Lilo shuts and locks the door, and searches for the antidote. Jumba starts pounding on the door, threatening to destroy her and the rest of the ohana. Lilo discovers the remedy: Angel must sing her song backwards. Lilo plays a recording of Angel's song backwards at the door, and Jumba stops. Lilo opens the door and Jumba greets her pleasantly; he is back to normal. 

A few minutes later, Lilo, Jumba, and Pleakley all drive to [[Waialeale Peak|Mount Waialeale]]. Lilo asks if Angel's song will turn Stitch evil. Jumba explains that both 625 and Stitch are immune to her powers since they were created after her. Inside the ship, 625 and Stitch are moping while Angel is looking proud of herself. 625 points out that even though Angel's song didn't affect them, they still fell for her charm. Angel sees Stitch's depressed face, then hears the ship starting its launch countdown. She stops smiling, and looks a little sad.

At the peak of the mountain, Lilo and the others arrive. The rock underneath them starts to shake and crumble. The spaceship emerges from the mountain and its rockets warm up. Lilo sees Stitch looking out one of the ships windows. Lilo runs up to the ship, but the countdown ends, and the ship starts to lift into the air. Inside, a navigation device comes out of the floor. Stitch runs over to destroy it, but an electrified glass shield is placed over it, causing him to get zapped. Gantu then presses a button on a remote, and releases the other experiments from their glass containers. He orders them all to pummel Stitch. The experiments all grab hold of him, and Kixx steps forward, ready to attack. Stitch locks eyes with Angel, and says goodbye to her. Angel is horrified, and yells for Kixx to stop. She then starts singing her song backwards, despite Gantu's protests. The experiments all turn good again, and let Stitch go. They then surround Gantu, ready to attack him. Before they do, Stitch tells Sparky to short out the electrical shield on the navigation device, then tells Richter to cause a tremor that splits the dome in half. Stitch is able to get inside, then rips the device out of its base. The navigation system fails, causing the spaceship to start falling from the sky. 

Lilo, Jumba, and Pleakley quickly drive away from the crashing ship as it tears up the ground upon re-entry. Once the ship slows to a stop, Lilo jumps out and calls for Stitch. Stitch escapes from the wreck, followed by the other experiments, who cheer for their cousin. Lilo and Stitch reunite, and Lilo asks what happened to Angel. Stitch tells her that Angel was the one who saved him, as she comes out of the ship and holds Stitch's hand. Lilo is stunned, but happy that Angel is now good. Stitch repeats what Lilo told him earlier, "You gotta believe in love." Pleakley, who was filming the whole time, declares that this is the finale to his masterpiece. 

However, Gantu comes out of the wreck, and runs towards the group, bumping Pleakley and making him drop his camera. Gantu crushes it under his foot, and aims his net gun at Stitch. He fires, and traps Stitch in the net, then traps Angel in a glass container. He runs off with her, followed by 625, who taunts them. Pleakley is upset that his documentary is ruined, and Stitch is sad that Angel is gone again. Lilo hugs Stitch, and tells him that they will get Angel back someday.

Babyfier (episode).plot: [[Babyfier (151)|An experiment that regresses people into babies]] activates and turns [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]] and [[Gantu]] into infants, forcing [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] to babysit them (Gantu for 625, and everyone else listed for Lilo). When Babyfier gets loose, Baby Stitch and Baby Gantu battle for the experiment, while Baby Pleakley and Baby Jumba (who still has the intellect of adult Jumba) have to mix an antidote for the age regression, requiring adult coffee in the remedy. In the end, Stitch unleashes it and everyone is changed back to normal (except Gantu, who remains a baby for now). Afterwards, Babyfier is given his one true place at the [[Aloha Animal Rescue|dog pound]], turning old dogs into more adoptable puppies.

Bad Stitch.plot: [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] has been receiving a lot of bills for [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]]'s destruction and unruly behavior, so she gets [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] to try and train him to be more civilized (otherwise, she will have to get rid of him forever). When Lilo's attempts prove to be unsuccessful, Stitch decides to find a way to make money for the Pelekais and ends up being kidnapped by [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Dr. Hämsterviel]], who [[Transmutation|plans to turn him evil again]]. Now, Lilo, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] must rescue Stitch before it's too late. Meanwhile, after getting fired by Hämsterviel, [[Gantu]] searches for a new job.

Belle (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], and [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] go out on a hiking adventure to try to prove the existence of the legendary [[wikipedia:Nightmarchers|Night Marchers]] (an ancient Hawaiian legend), and later tell each other frightening stories while waiting for the rain to clear up. Meanwhile, [[Belle (248)|an experiment that produces a loud, high-pitched shriek]] is being pursued by [[Gantu]].

Bonnie & Clyde.plot: After being grounded for being rowdy, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] sneak out of their [[Lilo's House|house]] and soon meet a criminal [[Bonnie (149)|experiment]] [[Clyde (150)|duo]], who urge them to do whatever they want and convince them that it won't do any harm. After causing trouble around the [[Kauai|island]] and realizing the consequences of their naughty behavior, though, Lilo and Stitch decide to capture the two crooks to redeem themselves. They pretend that they are working with Bonnie and Clyde again, but once they are taken to their hideout, they capture the thieves who are then taken to their one true place: prison. As for Lilo and Stitch, they have to clean up the mess they made as repayment for their crimes.

Bugby (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] builds a town called [[Bugopolis]] for her new friends in her bug collection, but [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], who has an uncontrollable craving for insects, keeps trying to eat the citizens. He loses his appetite, though, after [[Bugby (128)|a bug-like experiment]] turns Lilo, Stitch, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]] into insects. With the help of bugs named [[Chaps, Manny and Sperk]], they have to find a way to change themselves back soon because [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] has called an exterminator.

Cannonball (episode).plot:
A little bird notices an experiment pod in its nest. It flings it out, and the pod lands in a nearby lake. When [[Cannonball (520)|the experiment]] activates, it causes the water to form a massive wave that washes over the nearby area. The experiment hops away on his large bottom, making his way towards the beach.

Meanwhile, at the [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula halau]], [[Moses Puloki|Moses]] is telling his students about the sand-sculpting contest taking place at [[Lahui Beach|the beach]]. The theme of the sculpture must represent what "''aloha''" means. He looks over the girls' hand-drawn designs and ultimately chooses [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]]'s: a likeness of Duke Kahanamoku. [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] arrives late and tries submitting her sculpture idea, but its macabre details disgust Mertle and [[Elena|her]] [[Teresa|hula]] [[Yuki|friends]]. She tears up Lilo's drawing. In retaliation, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] terrorizes them.

Later at the [[Lilo's House|house]], Lilo and Stitch try coming up with new sculpture ideas, but they are interrupted by an explosion in the kitchen. [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] made some "improvements" to the stove, and cooked [[Pleakley]]'s meatloaf into a solid brick. Lilo talks to Jumba and Pleakley about the sand-sculpting contest. Jumba tells her that the classic sandcastle is a good design, but he and Pleakley admit that Duke Kahanamoku is a better design. This depresses Lilo. At that moment, [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] and [[David Kawena|David]] arrive. David says he has an idea of how to cheer up Lilo. He brings her, Nani, and Stitch to the [[Birds of Paradise Hotel]] to sneak into the guests-only pool.

At the pool, Lilo and Stitch go on a photo safari, while Nani and David get busted for sneaking in. Lilo then notices that [[Gantu]] is at the pool. He is chasing the experiment, who makes his way to the diving board. He jumps in, and causes the water in the pool to swell into a giant wave. Everyone runs away as well as they can, but the water washes away the pool chairs and a few people. After the water recedes, Stitch traps Gantu inside of a few life preservers and sends him rolling away. The experiment gets closer to the beach, stopping for a moment to land on top of a palm tree. Stitch quickly pulls the fronds of the tree, then releases, sending the experiment flying into the forest beyond. Stitch uses complex math to find out where the experiment landed, and he and Lilo head home to find faster transportation.

Lilo tells Nani they need to borrow her car to catch the experiment, but she refuses, and heads off to work. Jumba asks about the experiment that is loose, and Lilo describes it. Jumba tells her that Experiment 520 turns any body of water into a tidal wave. He adds that if it gets to the ocean, it will cause a tsunami that will destroy the world. To help them find the experiment faster, Jumba unveils his new [[X-Buggy]], made from Nani's old dune buggy. Pleakley insists that the pair at least being some food with them on their mission and gives them a whole pineapple. 

Lilo and Stitch search through the forest for 520, and see him heading towards the Waita Reservoir. Before he can destroy nearby buildings with the reservoir's water, Stitch harpoons him with a plunger gun and pulls him away. But, Gantu arrives and stomps Stitch into the dirt. He picks up the scared 520, but Stitch recovers, then bats Gantu away with the X-Buggy. Stitch follows Gantu and 520 into the trees, and they scuffle. Eventually, Stitch falls out of the tree, seemingly unconscious. Gantu takes his full sack and leaves. But, Stitch promptly gets up, and gets 520 down from the tree. Gantu presents the contents of his sack to [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]], revealing it to be the pineapple from earlier.

520 is very afraid of Lilo and Stitch. But, Lilo calms him down by explaining that she and Stitch are friends, and greeting him with an "aloha". This reminds her of the sand sculpting contest, which she is officially late for. Lilo, Stitch, and 520 make their way to the beach. Mertle and her friends are working on their sculpture, but scream and panic at 520. Moses tells them to calm down and get back to their sculpture, then thanks Lilo for coming to help, declaring that this is what "aloha" is about. But, the festivities are interrupted by Gantu stomping his way towards Stitch and 520. Stitch quickly builds a large sandcastle, and takes Lilo and 520 to the top out of Gantu's reach. Gantu tries knocking it down. 520 jumps down from the tower and towards the ocean, to Lilo and Stitch's dismay. But, when 520 hits the water, the wave he produces is just big enough to wash Gantu out to sea, but leave the rest of the beach intact. Grateful, Lilo gives 520 his new name: Cannonball. Moses arrives and presents Lilo's sandcastle with the first place ribbon, saying that she and her friends showed a lot of "aloha" that day.

Lilo decides that Cannonball's one true place is at the beach, making waves for all the surfers to surf in. Meanwhile, Gantu finally washes onto shore...in San Francisco, California.

Checkers (episode).plot:
[[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] are out in the garden playing in the mud with [[Digger (529)|Digger]], [[Yin (501)|Yin]], and [[Backhoe (040)|Backhoe]] until they get into trouble with [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] and [[Pleakley]] for filling the fridge and the oven with mud, turning the living room furniture upside down, and making a mummy kitchen scarecrow out of Pleakley's spoon collection. Both of them end up getting grounded. Meanwhile, [[Reuben|625]] has gotten a pet cockroach named [[Jimmy the Cockroach|Jimmy]], much to [[Gantu]]'s disgust. Just then, the [[Experiment Pod Container|experiment pod container]] reports that [[Checkers (029)|Experiment 029]] has been activated, designed to crown people, giving them the power of command over all living creatures. So, Gantu heads out to capture it.

The next day, the [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]] is deciding on float designs for the Coconut Queen Festival parade. Lilo's idea gets rejected and [[Moses Puloki|Moses]] chooses [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]]'s idea, a princess castle. Lilo walks sadly home with Stitch when they spot Gantu chasing after Experiment 029. They take 029 from Gantu and escape home. After Lilo looks up 029, he sits on her head and makes her queen, and everyone, except Stitch, suddenly worships and obeys her under hypnotic control. Lilo calls him Checkers and starts to take advantage of being queen, but eventually decides to step down after Mertle and the hula girls arrest many "troublemakers" for defying her. Checkers comes down from her head, but just before she can figure out his one true place Gantu arrives and grabs Checkers. After putting him on his head, Gantu becomes king over everyone, including Lilo.

Since Stitch and 625 are immune to Checkers' hypnotic effect, they rally together an army of other [[experiments]] to overthrow Gantu for the sake of everyone's freedom. King Gantu resides in the [[Birds of Paradise Hotel]], which he is using as a palace. Stitch and his cousins attack Gantu and rescue Lilo. [[Holio (606)|Holio]] tries to suck Checkers off Gantu's head, but instead sucks off his clothes. 625 sends his pet cockroach Jimmy to creep up on him. In his panic, Checkers falls off Gantu's head. He quickly puts him back on his head, but mistakes [[Elastico (345)|Elastico]]. Free of his control, Gantu's ex-servants revolt against him and kick him out. Afterwards, Lilo and the Experiments help rebuild the float, using everyone's ideas and make Nani the Coconut Queen.

As for Gantu, he is forced to clean the [[Gantu's Ship|ship]]'s bathroom as punishment while being bossed around by [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Dr. Hämsterviel]] and 625.

Clip (episode).plot:
[[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] is teaching [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] about fitting in on Earth by being obsessed with appearance and taking him to a spa. While there, Stitch attempts to eat mud from a mud bath, but he spits it out on Lilo because it tastes terrible. Immediately a mud fight breaks out in the spa and the store owner scolds them. They are told to clean up the mud and leave, but as soon as they exit, they hear the screams of a man nearby yelling, "My hair!" and pointing at [[Clip (177)|one of Stitch's cousins]].

Lilo and Stitch chase the alien, who is going on a hair-eating rampage and giving everyone bad haircuts. Stitch is able to capture the experiment in a hatbox outside of the [[Birds of Paradise Hotel]]. Lilo decides to name the alien. Stitch believes she should call her Hairy, but Lilo tells him that her name will be Clip. [[Gantu]] is watching nearby and angrily exclaims, "Blitznak!" when he loses his chance to nab the experiment. [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] scolds Gantu for failing and tells him to get the alien.

[[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] is not happy to see Experiment 177 because she ate his long, luxurious hair as soon as he created her leaving him with only three hairs. He says that when creating the experiment, he had in mind for it to eat [[Uburnium]], a rare space fuel. He made a mistake, however, because in one alien language Uburnium and hair were the same word. When 177 emerged, she quickly devoured Jumba's hair. [[Pleakley]] overhears this story and tells Jumba that to grow hair he should relax. Jumba desires to destroy Clip, but Lilo wants to find her one true home.

The next day, she takes Clip to the [[Beauty Parlor|hair salon]], which has a hair problem, but before she can deliver the alien, she sees [[Mertle Edmonds]] and [[Elena]], [[Teresa]], and [[Yuki]]. Mertle insults Lilo's hairstyle and gives her conditioner "for taming wild, unruly hair". Lilo is angry and decides that Mertle should be punished.

Stitch and Lilo stealthily sneak into [[Mertle's House|Mertle's house]]. Using his infrared vision to see through the walls, Stitch says that the house is all clear and the two sneak in. Upon climbing in through the window, they leave Clip under Mertle's pillow, but before they can leave, [[Mrs. Edmonds]] comes in. She is confused as to why Lilo and Stitch are there, and the little girl says it was to drop off an early birthday present for Mertle.

That night, Lilo creates a story of what she believes will happen to Mertle's red hair after it is eaten by Clip. However, Clip instead eats the yarn hair of one of Mertle's dolls, which she then spits out as it tastes disgusting to her. Gantu suddenly opens the window and scares Clip. Investigating the sound of the noises, Mrs. Edmonds opens the door and her head is attacked by Experiment 177, leaving her bald. The alien is able to get away but gets onto a bus and presumably eats more hair.

The next morning, Lilo rushes to [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula class]] to see Mertle without hair but is disappointed when she sees that nothing is different about Mertle. The bully explains she had a sleepover last night and how her mom is now bald because her hair was scared off. By the story, Lilo is able to piece together that Clip was snatched by Gantu.

When Lilo and Stitch return home, they see Jumba and Pleakley attempting to find a perfect wig for Jumba. He turns down a rainbow Afro, so Pleakley begins massaging Jumba's scalp with his feet. Jumba promises to help catch Experiment 177. They burst into the Edmonds' home and scare Mertle's mom. As she screams, Jumba blasts a net onto her.

They sort out the misunderstanding calmly, and Mrs. Edmonds tells Lilo that she is actually happy with the haircut. She says that a haircut doesn't make a person, but rather the person makes the haircut what it is. Jumba is unhappy with his baldness until Mertle's mom compliments his head shape. Because he becomes less stressed about his poor situation, his hair is able to freely grow and bursts forth from his scalp, much to his excitement.

As they are pursuing Clip, Jumba decides to perform maintenance on his new hair. Soon a hairless squirrel and a scared Gantu rush by, running from a humongous hairball. While trying to save Lilo and Jumba from Clip's hair appetite, Stitch is run over by 177 and his rear end is shaven. Gantu runs from the alien and falls from a cliff into a hula demonstration. He dances skillfully for the enjoyment of onlookers.

Lilo vows never to unleash a hair-eating monster on an enemy again. Jumba begins getting split ends due to the stress, so Lilo offers him the conditioner for wild, unruly hair. She then realizes that this is what she needs to tame Clip since she's "nothing but wild and unruly hair." They discover that the salon is where Clip will be terrorizing. Using the conditioner, Stitch douses Experiment 177, causing her to shrink. Now that Clip is calmed down, she gives a surfer a haircut, which he says is "the real me."

Giving people haircuts at the spa and salon is Clip's one true place. Jumba even gives up his Afro because he realizes that having only three hairs is the real him. Lilo apologizes to the owner of the salon who offers her a free haircut, but Lilo says she is happy with her hair just the way it is.

While Gantu is still hula dancing and apparently enjoying himself, he receives a call from Dr. Hämsterviel. However, he ignores it by throwing his communicator behind him and keeps dancing as it lands in a cup of punch.

Drowsy (episode).plot:
[[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] is in a hurry and all over the place. She is running late for [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula class]] after finding twelve new [[Experiment Pods|experiment pods]] for [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] to catalog. However, he himself is too busy with other things, so he leave the pods with [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] to catalog. After showing up late for [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula class]] for the third time, [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] has a serious talk with Lilo. She has not only been late for Hula class several times, but she also forgot to help [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] at her [[Hasagawa Fruits|fruit stand]]. Her experiment hunting has been interfering with her other responsibilities; she does not get enough sleep, she is always stressed out, and always running late. Unless Lilo can find a way to balance her experiment hunting with her other responsibilities, Nani will have to ban her from chasing [[experiments]].

[[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] worries about Lilo, especially when she stays up late to check on their experiment catalog. He tries to get her to go to sleep, but fails as Lilo tiredly remains focused on finishing their catalog. She sends Stitch to see if Pleakley has finished cataloging the new experiment pods. Among the twelve pods is [[Drowsy (360)|Experiment 360]]: designed to cause populations to fall into a near-permanent sleep. After Pleakley goes to bed, Stitch takes 360's pod and activates it. Then he brings him to Lilo, who instantly puts her to sleep by simply bleating. Meanwhile, the [[Experiment Pod Container|container]] alerts [[Gantu]] and [[Reuben (625)|625]] of 360's activation, but Gantu decides to sleep on it. Suddenly, [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] calls in, demanding him to go after the experiment. He also happens to have other plans. He has been monitoring Earth's television transmissions for over a month, and believes he has identified the most powerful human on the planet. All he knows is, this person is always on the TV and believes he uses mind control to memorize humanity. In two days time, he will be in Hawaii and needs Gantu to kidnap him by using 360.

The next morning, Stitch finds Lilo still fast asleep. He tries to wake her but she is completely out cold, even when he plays a loud trumpet. Lilo is supposed to be helping Mrs. Hasagawa at her fruit stand. So, Stitch takes charge of her appointments while carrying Lilo around, wearing glasses. Meanwhile, 360 escapes and goes around putting everyone to sleep with his bleating. Jumba and Pleakley go after him, and so does Gantu. At Lilo's Hula recital, Stitch puppeteers Lilo across the stage with rope tied to her wrists and waist. Despite the awkward performance, the audience applause. [[Mr. Jameson]] is so impressed that he invites Lilo to be his Aloha greeter who for a very important guest. Stitch is unable to turn down the offer as Mr. Jameson will not take "no" for an answer and leaves before he can say anything.

Stitch, incredibly exhausted, returns home with Lilo, who is still asleep. Jumba and Pleakley have also returned home after failing to capture 360. It is only then, Jumba reveals that spraying water in the face wakes Lilo from her deep sleep. Lilo at first worries because of what Nani said, but Stitch assures her that he took care of all her appointments except one. The next day, Lilo and Stitch are at the airport as ''aloha'' greeters for this very important guest. After the plane arrives, they find that the VIP is [[wikipedia:Regis Philbin|Regis Philbin]], who has come to Hawaii for a well-earned vacation.

Mr. Philbin also happens to be the supreme earthling Hämsterviel wants to kidnap. After being up all night, Gantu was able to capture Experiment 360. Now he and 625 are waiting for Mr. Philbin at the [[Birds of Paradise Hotel]], disguised as valets. When Lilo and Stitch arrive at the hotel with Mr. Philbin and notice Gantu, they suspect trouble. So, they take him round the back and escort him to his hotel. While Lilo keeps Mr. Philbin distracted, Stitch fights off Gantu and 625 who try to pull off all sorts of tricks to kidnap Mr. Philbin. Eventually, Mr. Philbin begins to notice their odd behavior, but suspects they have been protecting him from autograph hunters, which he is thankful of. Lilo invites him to stay at her house instead of the hotel, which he accepts. At the end of the day, everyone, including Lilo and Mr. Philbin, fall peacefully asleep.

Dupe (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] hosts a slumber party, but none of her classmates from [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]] come. When she finds [[Dupe (344)|an experiment that creates duplicates]], she tries to clone herself so that she can have her own friends. [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] saves her, but is cloned instead. Stitch is weakened by the duplication when his strength is divided among all the clones. [[Gantu]] is now able to use several experiments to capture Stitch. Lilo tricks Gantu into using Dupe to turn his few experiments into an army and then merges the Stitches back into one full-strength Stitch.

Elastico (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] ignores [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] while working on a new hula dance. Stitch finds [[Elastico (345)|a cousin performing as a circus entertainer]] and when he attempts to capture Elastico, he is adopted as a circus performer himself. [[Gantu]] captures and nearly sends Elastico to [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]], but he manages to escape and returns to the circus. When Lilo realizes that Stitch has left, she apologizes to him for ignoring him and convinces him to stay in Hawaii and not travel with his new circus family.

Experiment Zero.plot: Stitch is hired by the [[Grand Councilwoman]] to save the universe from the evil [[Zero (000)|Experiment Zero]].

Felix (episode).plot:
[[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Dr. Hämsterviel]] sends [[Felix (010)|Experiment 010]] back to [[Gantu]] because he has been driving him crazy. Gantu is not happy to have 010 back, and decides to throw him out soon after being teleported. Meanwhile, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] is playing video games when he notices [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] has boarded up the windows. It is time for his bath, and Lilo has sealed off any chance of escape. Lilo chases Stitch around with a soap and brush, making a lot of mess behind them. [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] arrives home to pack for an overnight trip, and while she is away asks Lilo and Stitch to keep the [[Lilo's House|house]] tidy. [[Pleakley]] intends to make sure that they do, but soon after Nani leaves Lilo and Stitch run off to [[Lahui Beach|the beach]], celebrating their newfound freedom. However, they find that [[Cannonball (520)|Cannonball]] has been causing a lot of waves that have caused rubbish to wash up on the beach. They get him to stop and as they start cleaning up the mess, 010 shows up and does the job for them. They capture him in a picnic basket, just as [[Moses Puloki|Moses]] shows up to clean the beach. He is amazed by how tidy the beach is and assumes that it was Lilo who did it. He offers her and Stitch to help with the spring cleaning at the [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]], but they decline.

Lilo and Stitch return home with 010, who Lilo has named Felix since all neat freaks on TV are called that. According to [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], 010 is designed to be a total neat freak and keep everything spick-and-span. Equipped with tiny brushes and hormonal detergents, he has three functions: automatically tidy up all messes, digest process all garbage and trash, and antisceptisize against all unhealthy germs and sources of filth. Lilo thinks Felix would make a good friend for Pleakley, but objects mainly because he is one of Jumba's evil [[experiments]]. Lilo is certain that Felix is not dangerous, but still asks Jumba if it is true. Jumba recalls a certain flaw with 010, but is certain he fixed that problem long ago. However, soon after everyone leaves the room, Felix spots a fly and sterilizes it with lasers from his nose, indicating that Felix may be dangerous after all.

After agreeing they already have one neat freak at home, Lilo and Stitch bring Felix to the hula school to help with the spring cleaning, thinking he could work as the janitor. Felix immediately starts cleaning the auditorium, and so far it all goes well until he tries to digest Moses' oriental rug. Lilo tries to tell him it's not trash, but she gets her upper body stuck in his trunk and Stitch takes hold of her legs and gets her unstuck. Lilo takes the blame, and Moses kindly asks her to go home. Pretty soon, Lilo and Stitch are no longer impressed with Felix. His obsessive cleanliness starts to get annoying, but Pleakley starts to like when he sees how useful he is around the house. However, his tone changes when Felix throws out his antique sewing machine. To make matters worse, Felix traps Lilo, Stitch, and Jumba in the house. It is at this point that Jumba remembers that he did not fix the flaw in 010's programming. The flaw was that Felix viewed all organisms (including people) as germs that must be sterilized at all cost. This means that he sees Lilo, Stitch, and Jumba as germs to antisceptisize.

Felix relentlessly pursues Lilo, Stitch and Jumba around the house, shooting his laser nose at them until they were able to trap him in a container. Eventually, they capture Felix and Jumba starts work on reprogramming him to be less of a neat freak. After a while, Jumba presents Felix to Lilo, Stitch, and Pleakley, no longer obsessively neat. Lilo tests him out by making a mess. As expected, Felix does not react, not even if she makes the mess she made worse. Just then, Felix approaches the mess, but instead of cleaning it up he makes a much bigger mess throughout the house when he gives a big blow through his nose. It turns out that instead of just liking dirt, Jumba's reprogramming has caused Felix to begin making things incredibly dirty. Now, he was more of an Oscar than a Felix. To make matters worse, Nani calls saying she is coming home early. Since there is not time to reprogram Felix again, and Pleakley refuses to clean for Lilo, she and Stitch reluctantly go around the house cleaning up the mess themselves. They finish giving each other a bath just as Nani walks through the door, very impressed with how tidy the house is.

As for Felix, Lilo and Stitch give him back to Gantu. He is at first delighted to see Felix until he realizes too late that Felix is no longer a neat freak when he starts to mess up his recently tidied ship.

Fibber (episode).plot:
[[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] return home with another Experiment: 032, a lie detector. According to [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], 032 forces people to tell the truth, with the belief that civilizations will fall into chaos when forced to tell the truth all the time. Lilo nicknames 032 "[[Fibber (032)|Fibber]]" and, after being ratted out for a lie, decides to leave him in Stitch's care. Stitch is not thrilled to have to keep an eye on Fibber. The following night, [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]]'s [[Galactic Communicator|phone]] rings, waking up Lilo and Jumba. The caller is [[Mrs. Pleakley|his mother]], who calls him night and day to find a wife to marry. Pleakley does not want to get married, and prefers his Earth studies. He refuses to answer his phone, but Lilo answers it for him. Pleakley's mother announces that she has found him a bride, and have gone ahead in making arrangements for a big wedding and to bring him home. Pleakley is upset by the news, so Lilo urges him to tell his mother that he already has a fiancée. Pleakley manages to successfully lie (even with Fibber buzzing in the background), only for his mother, his sister [[Pixley Pleakley|Pixley]], and his brother [[Bertley Pleakley|Bertley]] to show up at the house shortly thereafter.

Needing a girl to pose as Pleakley's fiancée, Lilo decides to convince [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] to pretend to be the fiancée. Nani is reluctant, but only relents after Lilo asks Jumba if she could play with a chainsaw, proving how irresponsible Jumba would be as her caretaker should Pleakley leave. As the ''ʻohana'' and Pleakley's family talk about her and Pleakley's "wedding", Nani begins to have second thoughts when Mrs. Pleakley states that Pleakley and her should have a proper ceremony to exchange "intergalactically eternal binding vows". [[David Kawena|David]] calls the house and learns of Nani's "engagement" from Pixley, to his shock and confusion. Meanwhile, Stitch is driven crazy by Fibber's continuous buzzing as he keeps trying to keep him quiet. It is only when Mrs. Pleakley informs Nani that she got a real minister from Las Vegas to officiate the wedding does she bail out. Although distraught by Nani's refusal, Lilo manages to get Jumba to become Pleakley's new fiancée, "Jumbina". 

The wedding ceremony manages to go off without a hitch, but before Pleakley and "Jumbina" can be declared husband and wife, David shows up with a bouquet of flowers, still assuming that Nani is still getting married, but realizes his mistake when he sees Nani in the house. As he is trying to explain himself, [[Gantu]] shows up after being on vacation without Hämsterviel's approval. Gantu tries and fails to capture Fibber, but is defeated and thrown away by Stitch. However, Gantu manages to reveal to Pleakley's family of Fibber's nature as a lie detector. Pixley, Pleakley's mother, and Bertley proceed to say mean things about Pleakley to his face, only for Fibber to buzz at everything they say, revealing that their words are not true. Bertley admits that he was jealous of Pleakley, as he thinks he is tall, handsome, and a babe magnet. Pixley confesses that she thought Pleakley was creative, and tried to make herself more ambitious than him so that she could be better. But all it has gotten her was "high-powered career, a custom shoe closet, and bone-searing loneliness!" Their mother tearfully admits their struggles are all her fault; she pushed them to be successful because she wanted them to be happy. She also thinks Pleakley is not happy because he is not married, but Pleakley finally admits that he does not want to be married at all, content to be single.

As the Pleakley family prepare to leave, Lilo wonders where Fibber's one true place is. Before she can figure it out, Gantu appears and steals Fibber. Pleakley's mother tries to go after him, but Lilo decides that Gantu needs a little chaos in his life and lets him have Fibber. Back at the spaceship, Gantu tries to explain himself to [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]], only to have Fibber buzz whenever he tells a lie. Hämsterviel puts him on probation, while [[Reuben (625)|625]] and Fibber become buddies.

Finder (episode).plot: [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] becomes jealous of [[Finder (158)|a new experiment]] when [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] takes Finder to show-and-tell instead of Stitch. Meanwhile, [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] escapes from [[Prison Asteroid K-37|prison]] and travels to Earth, where he is "adopted" by [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]]. While the [[Grand Councilwoman]] offers to reinstate [[Gantu]]'s position for the capture of Dr. Hämsterviel, Stitch strives to upstage Finder by finding him first. Mertle is captured by Gantu by accident and Stitch and Finder team up to rescue her, with Finder flying Stitch to [[Gantu's Ship|Gantu's ship]]. Stitch disables Gantu's ship and Mertle is rescued, while the Grand Councilwoman takes Hämsterviel into custody but doesn't reinstate Gantu due to him kidnapping Mertle. Finder is put to work running a "Lost and Found" at [[Lahui Beach|the beach]].

Frenchfry (episode).plot:
[[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] arrive downstairs for breakfast and find [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] cooking instead of [[Pleakley]], who went to drop [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] off at the [[Kauai Airport|airport]]. Nani serves them oatmeal for breakfast, which Lilo and Stitch refuse to eat. It is at this point that Nani realizes that Pleakley has been letting Lilo eat junk food, disregarding her health. When he gets back from the airport, Nani instructs Pleakley to make sure she eats the nutritious meals she has prepared for her in the fridge. As before Lilo and Stitch refuse to eat the meals Nani has prepared, and decide to go on a hunger strike. Even Pleakley shows disgust towards healthy food. When Nani comes home for lunch and finds that none of them are even trying to eat healthy, she decides to ban all junk food in the [[Lilo's House|house]].

Nani confiscates Pleakley's hidden stash and takes it to the trash. Then firmly instructs him to prepare a nutritious meal by the time she gets back from work. "No more junk" she says. With everyone now worried, Stitch looks into Jumba's draw and brings out an [[Experiment Pods|experiment pod]], numbered [[Frenchfry (062)|062]]. According to [[Jumba's Computer|Jumba's computer]], Experiment 062 is designed to prepare delectable and irresistible meals. They waste no time activating 062, who straight away begins cooking up a delicious unhealthy meal for Lilo, Stitch, and Pleakley. He prepares a large amount of hamburgers, french fries, pizzas and ice cream Sundaes. Lilo, Stitch, Pleakley dig in, consuming everything on the table. Little do they know that they are starting to grow fat as they eat. After eating ten burgers (Pleakley ate twelve), fifteen pizzas, nine Sundaes, and many plates of fries, Lilo, Stitch and Pleakley become all round and fat. Strangely enough, neither of them feel full. So, they decide to keep on eating, which makes 062, now called Frenchfry, give off a devious smirk.

Lilo does not notice the side effects of Frenchfry's meals until she realizes she is late for Hula class. She shows up, but accidentally rolls over everyone like a bowling ball. Eventually, Lilo and Stitch decide to look up more on Frenchfry. Apparently, they find nothing that helps explain the reasons behind the extra weight they've gain while eating Frenchfry's meals. All they got from a video diary was that 062 was designed to be Jumba's personal chef but curiously had trouble resisting his meals and never felt full. Frenchfry gets Lilo and Stitch eating again, and they get more fatter. Just then, [[Gantu]] shows up to capture Frenchfry. Despite being overweight, Stitch still manages to take on Gantu by bouncing on him. Because it is also his birthday, Frenchfry tempts Gantu with a birthday cake, which he consumes and suddenly grows fat. After Gantu retreats, Lilo decides to call Jumba.

Meanwhile, Jumba is in the middle of presenting his genetically engineered house pet to the scientific community when he gets a call from Lilo. She asks him about Experiment 062, and when she tells him that they reactivated him Jumba warns her to resist eating his meals. It turns that Frenchfry is actually trying to fatten them up so he can eat them himself. This is proven right when Frenchfry takes Lilo and Stitch into the yard where he prepares a fire to cook them on. When Nani hears from [[Moses Puloki|Moses]] of what happened at hula class, she calls Jumba as well. He confirms that Lilo and Stitch had gotten fat due to overeating Frenchfry's meals, which will wear off after twenty-four hours. However, he warns her that his experiment will try to eat them and must hurry home. Nani arrives just in time to save Lilo and Stitch, and battles against Frenchfry. With Lilo and Stitch's help, she beats Frenchfry and traps him under a swimming pool. Meanwhile, an overweight Gantu arrives back on his ship and finds his former colleagues greeting him "Happy Birthday", much to his anger as he states that it isn't his birthday, even though it is.

The next day, Lilo, Stitch and Pleakley are back to normal. Nani again serves them oatmeal, but this time cleverly entices Lilo that it is actually "mummy chow". This encourages her to eat her oatmeal, along with some honey a.k.a. "ectoplasmic slime". Frenchfry has also taken a liking to Nani's oatmeal, and vows to make healthy meals and never again try to eat people.

Glitch (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] is tired of doing chores and asks [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] to build a machine to help her, so he ends up upgrading the entire house to do the chores itself. However, when [[Glitch (223)|an experiment]] enters the computer control system and glitches it up, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] must fight the [[Lilo's House|house]] to rescue everyone.

Heckler (episode).plot: [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] is having trouble organizing a charity dinner, so [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] offers to help entertain the audience by providing stand-up comedy. However, when [[Heckler (322)|an experiment designed to mock people]] appears, he starts to make personal insults toward everyone and leads [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] down the wrong path. Now, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] must stop Heckler before his heckling ruins the event. Luckily, Pleakley inadvertently figures out how when he insults himself after failing his stand-up comedy routine. Everyone else starts making fun of themselves as well and Pleakley's act winds up successful. Lilo and Stitch figure out Heckler's one true place and a way for everyone to get back at him at the same time…dunking him at a dunking booth.

Holio (episode).plot: [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] receives a charm bracelet for her birthday, but one of the charms is actually [[Holio (606)|an experiment pod]]. [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] must try to retrieve it before she gets it wet, or else the universe will be sucked into a black hole. Meanwhile, [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] must prepare for a company inspection; however, Lilo keeps getting caught by [[Officer Kahiko]], leaving Nani to shirk her duties. Fortunately, with [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s help, Lilo and Stitch manage to defeat Holio's black hole.

Houdini (episode).plot: [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] and [[Pleakley]] are hired to do a magic show at [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]]'s "half-birthday" party. After their act turns out to be horrible, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] secretly activates [[Houdini (604)|an experiment that turns things invisible]] to help make the show a success. When it is, [[Aunt Stacy|Mertle's aunt]], a Hollywood producer, hires them to do their trick on national television. However, when Houdini runs away and leaves Stitch invisible, Lilo tries to find them both before she looks like a fraud. Meanwhile, [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] finds [[Fudgy (054)|119]]'s experiment pod at the grocery store, mistaking it for 611's pod, but [[Gantu]] takes all the credit for it while trying to find Houdini. In the end, Houdini arrives just in time to make the disappearing [[Kilauea Lighthouse|lighthouse]] magic trick work. He is then revealed to be the true magician and gets a magic show with Mertle's aunt.

Hunkahunka (episode).plot:
While [[Pleakley]] is cleaning and watching a beauty pageant, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] burst into the house. Lilo is hollering about the approaching catastrophe. She explains to Pleakley that while out in town, she saw [[Keoni Jameson]] holding a bouquet of flowers and asking someone for directions to the [[Lilo's House|Pelekai house]]. She believes he is going to ask her to the upcoming Lono-i-ke-aweawe Dance, but she isn't ready for his arrival. But, the doorbell rings. Lilo runs off to prepare, and Pleakley quickly puts on a wig. Stitch answers, and Keoni asks if the "beautiful young lady" is there. Stitch brings him to the couch, and Lilo approaches. She casually asks Keoni what he is doing, and he explains that he wants to ask the prettiest girl he knows to the dance. Lilo insists that he hurry and ask. But, to everyone's shock, he gives the bouquet to Pleakley, and asks "her" to the dance. This causes Lilo to physically throw Keoni out onto the porch. 

The group enters [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s room, and Lilo begins ranting about the situation. Jumba has an idea of what caused Keoni to fall for Pleakley. He believes Keoni is under the influence of [[Hunkahunka (323)|Experiment 323]], a pecking bird-like experiment who causes its victims to fall in hopelessly in love with the next person they see. Pleakley isn't convinced, saying that his disguise is perfect, and he makes a beautiful woman. Seeing the beauty pageant on TV again, he decides to emulate the international contestants to be more beautiful. Lilo asks if there is a cure for the love sickness. Jumba says yes, but the files on [[Jumba's Computer|his computer]] are all corrupted due to Stitch accidentally downloading a virus. He fixes the computer while Lilo and Stitch hunt for the experiment.

According to Jumba, the experiment, which Lilo has named Hunkahunka, is drawn to large crowds. Lilo and Stitch start their search at the beach, which is full of beachgoers. One of those beachgoers happens to be Keoni, and Lilo quickly goes to talk with him. Meanwhile, at the [[Rental Hut]], [[David Kawena|David]] is asking [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] to the dance. But, as soon as she agrees, Hunkahunka flies behind David, and pecks him. David's gaze drifts to a random woman, and he declares his love for her, angering Nani. 

Stitch spots Hunkahunka flying around. He goes to catch him, but [[Gantu]] arrives, ready with his net gun. The two of them fight, and Gantu gets the upper hand. He is about to launch Stitch into the ocean to drown, but Hunkahunka pecks him. As Gantu recoils from the peck, he sees Pleakley, dressed as a Spanish flamenco dancer, walking by. Gantu declares love for "her" and follows, leaving Stitch behind. Stitch quickly captures Hunkahunka in a drink cooler, and brings it to Lilo. Seizing the opportunity, Lilo takes the experiment out of the cooler, and makes it peck Keoni. He falls in love with Lilo, but Stitch isn't happy. He tries convincing Lilo to help Hunkahunka find his one true place. But, Lilo says they can do that after she and Keoni spend some time together.

Stitch brings the cooler home alone, and talks to Jumba. Jumba has successfully fixed his computer, and tells Stitch that the antidote to Hunkahunka's pecks is a splash of water to the face. Stitch arms himself with some spray bottles, and prepares to leave, but notices that Hunkahunka has escaped the cooler. Not only that, Gantu has arrived with flowers and candy for Pleakley. Stitch sprays Gantu, who snaps out of his love sickness. He leaves the flowers and candy on the porch, and chases after Hunkahunka along with Stitch. Pleakley, dressed in a Japanese kimono, opens the door to check out the noise. He sees the gifts, along with an invitation to the dance. 

Elsewhere, Lilo and Keoni have their date. Lilo notices Mertle and her friends approaching, and tells Keoni to ask her to the dance in front of them. He does so, and Mertle gets annoyed, saying that Keoni is now weird like Lilo. After the other girls leave, Lilo notices that Keoni is acting strange. Keoni keeps asking for Lilo's input on everything, and does everything she asks with an overly cheerful attitude. Lilo asks Keoni why he loves her. He says he doesn't know why, he just does. This depresses Lilo and she leaves Keoni alone.

After chasing Hunkahunka around all day, Stitch eventually corners him at the community center where the dance is taking place. He puts the experiment into a small ticket box by the door. Lilo arrives, saying she has had enough of Hunkahunka's artificial love. She asks if the antidote is inside the box, and opens it. Hunkahunka flies into the community center and starts pecking people at random. Even Nani is pecked, and falls for Gantu, who arrived at that moment. Lilo sprays whoever is pecked, while Stitch tries catching the experiment. This proves difficult due to the experiment's speed and everyone moving around to get to their "soulmates." Lilo realizes that the love sickness doesn't kick in until the victim actually sees another person. Stitch turns off the lights, and Hunkahunka continues pecking, but eventually pauses as no one has fallen in love yet. Then, Pleakley arrives and turns on the lights. Nearly everyone in the room turns their loving attention towards Pleakley. 

While Hunkahunka is distracted, Stitch knocks him out of the air, but Gantu catches him. Nani, still lovesick, approaches Gantu and tries to kiss him. But, he backs up into a fire alarm, which starts the sprinkler system. Water sprays onto everyone in the room, snapping them out of their love sickness. The people start leaving, and Gantu takes the opportunity to escape. Lilo tells Stitch to let Gantu take the experiment, since no one on Earth needs artificial love, and people should love one another as they are. Lilo and Stitch have a celebratory dance, and Nani apologizes to David for unintentionally falling for another man. Pleakley is sad that no one actually thought he was a beautiful woman. But, Keoni approaches and tells "Miss Pleakley" that "she" looks nice. Pleakley immediately sprays him, but Keoni says "she" is beautiful and quirky. Keoni really did have a crush on "Aunt Pleakley," much to Lilo's amusement, and Stitch's disgust.

At Gantu's ship, Gantu prepares to send Hunkhunka to [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]. The whole time, Hämsterviel is berating him. After the experiment is teleported, it pecks Hämsterviel, and he falls in love with Gantu. But, Hämsterviel continues to insult him, talking about his "cute, dumb face" and "funny, stupid things" he says.

Kixx (episode).plot: [[Kixx (601)|A combatant experiment]] causes trouble by bullying people around the [[Kauai|island]], and a chemical reaction from a bad snack combination results in [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] losing his ability to fight. [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] must re-train him so that he can defeat Kixx before [[Gantu]] does.

Lax (episode).plot: The [[disney:Recess|Recess gang]] visits [[Kauai]] so [[Gretchen Grundler|Gretchen]] can use a telescope to examine what she believes is a new planet. Meanwhile, [[Lax (285)|an experiment designed to make people stop working]] zaps [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], and [[Pleakley]] its lazy beam. [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] is forced to depend on her new friends to catch Lax while Stitch takes a vacation.

Link (episode).plot: When [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] are forced to work together to find buried treasure, [[Link (251)|an experiment that binds together uncooperative people with sticky elastic glue]] appears. Mertle helps Lilo catch Link, while [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] becomes stuck to [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] and [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] becomes stuck to [[Pleakley]].

Melty (episode).plot:
It is a windy day in [[Kokaua Town]]. The wind blows an [[Experiment Pods|Experiment Pod]] out of a palm tree and is carried away by a dog. The dog drops the pod in his bowl of water, resulting in the activation of [[Melty (228)|Experiment 228]]: designed to liquefy enemy fortresses, weapons, and transportation by firing blue energy blasts that melt any solid object when hit. [[Reuben (625)|625]] is informed by the [[Experiment Pod Container]], but decides not to tell [[Gantu]] who is asleep. Meanwhile, [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] is starting her new job at the [[Birds of Paradise Hotel]]. [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] has given her a professonal makeover, and Lilo gives her a creepy necklace made of garbage for good luck. By noon, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch]] head down to the hotel to check on Nani. Then, as the clock tower strikes twelve, Experiment 228 runs past them and causes Lilo to fall in a pool of mud. While Stitch goes after the Experiment, Keoni shows up in front of Lilo. Flattered and embarressed, Lilo tells Keoni she deliberately fell in the mud because she is practicing a hula about a mud monster. This leaves her even more embarressed. Meanwhile, Stitch chases 228 into the hotel parking lot. He climbs onto the roof, and once he has sight of his cousin, he jumps from the roof and catches him using a metal chimney cap.

The two return home with 228 with Lilo is still drowning in embarrassment. She wishes she could go back and redo the whole thing, and that is when Pleakley accidentally reveals that [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] has invented a [[Time Machine|time-travelling surfboard]]. However, he only built it for showing off purposes and is never meant to be used. Jumba warns Lilo and Stitch that meddling with the spacetime continuum can be unpredictable. One small change in the past can cause a big change in the future. Lilo ignores this warning, and as soon as Jumba is gone, the two bring out the time machine and travel back to noon.

They arrive outside the hotel as the clock strikes twelve. At that moment, Experiment 228 runs past them, but this time Lilo manages to save herself from falling in the mud. Stitch goes after 228 while Lilo makes conversations with [[Keoni Jameson|Keoni]]. The chase leads to the hotel like before, but Stitch's change of action causes 228 to run into the lobby and melt the hotel. Stitch manages to capture 228, but the incident gets Nani fired from her new job. Feeling bad for her sister, Lilo and Stitch decide to go back in time again, but this time with a plan. They arrive at the hotel as the clock strikes noon. Experiment 228 runs past them, Lilo saves herself from falling in the mud, and Stitch goes after the Experiment as Keoni shows up. This time, the chase goes around the hotel and into the parking lot like the first time. But when Stitch tries to react his original steps, he accidentally throws off the balance of a falling palm tree, which destroys [[Officer Kahiko]]'s car, resulting in Lilo and Stitch being thrown in prison. They travel back to noon again, and despite making a new plan, another incident happens. Lilo causes a chain reaction: she places her hand against a palm tree and startles a butterfly, causing it to fly above the ocean where a fish jumps up and eats it. An eagle snatches the fish and drops it onto a ship's windshield, which startles the captain and causes his ship to crash into the hotel.

Despite their efforts to avoid any incidents, something unexpected keeps happening, resulting in another redo. Stitch forgets to turn on the paradox inhibitor, therefore causing him and Lilo to meet themselves. Melty unintentionally hurls into the ocean, where his melting blasts open up a volcanic fissure in the ocean floor, causing a massive tsunami to form and destroy part of Kauai. And instead of going back in time, they travel far into the future. Eventually, Lilo and Stitch manage to avoid any mishaps. Lilo successfully talks to Keoni, Stitch catches the Experiment, the hotel is all right, Nani still has her job, and they are not in trouble. To make sure they do not mess anything else up, Lilo and Stitch head home with 228, whom Lilo has named "Melty". 

Just when they think everything has turned out alright, Stitch causes another chain reaction: he blows off a feather that falls onto his arm, causing it to land on an unstable coconut, which falls off its pile and bounces down a hill onto a golf tee. There, it gets whacked into the air by an elderly golfer and hits the hull of Gantu's ship with a loud thud, waking him up. When 625 reveals Melty's activation to Gantu, the latter shows up at [[Lilo's House|Lilo and Stitch's house]]. Melty breaks out of containment and melts the entire house and the time machine, allowing Gantu to capture the Experiment. Not only that, Nani lost her job after Gantu showed up at the hotel looking for the Experiment and wrecked the place. [[Mr. Jameson]] had to close the hotel and lay off the staff until it is repaired. With the time machine destroyed, Lilo and Stitch cannot go back in time and fix everything. Lilo is devastated and wishes she had never gone back in time in the first place. Just when it seems all hope is lost, a Jumba from the future shows up on a new time-travelling surfboard (whom Lilo and Stitch accidentally met when unintentionally going forward in time). He tells Lilo she can still fix everything, but she will have to relive the past exactly as it originally happened. That means Lilo will have to humiliate herself in front of Keoni. Future Jumba tells her it is the only way to restore the timeline, and she must learn to accept her mistakes. If she dwells on the past she will be unable to live in the present and lose sight of the future. Future Jumba sends Lilo and Stitch on their way and they arrive again at noon outside the hotel.

Right on queue, Melty runs past them and causes Lilo to fall in the mud. As Stitch goes after Melty and captures him for the eighth and final time, Keoni shows up and Lilo forcibly embarrasses herself in front of him. Thus, restoring the timeline. Despite Lilo humiliating herself, everything turns out better than expected. Nani got to keep her new job, and Keoni invites Lilo to a movie after giving her a mud monster doll. Meanwhile, Stitch is guarding Melty like a hawk in case Gantu shows up. While they are certain he will not, Lilo and Stitch do not want to take any chances. Gantu wakes up from his sleep much later, but instead of being informed about Melty's activation, 625 tells him he lasered a tattoo on his patookie. Gantu then decides to do the same to him.

Morpholomew (episode).plot: [[Keoni Jameson|Keoni]] is going away for the weekend, so [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] enters the [[Kauai|island]]'s skateboarding competition by using [[Morpholomew (316)|an experiment that can morph a person into any other organism]] in order to win a new skateboard for him. At the same time, [[Jake Long|Jake]], [[Trixie Carter|Trixie]], [[Arthur Spudinski|Spud]], [[Luong Lao Shi|Lao Shi]] and [[Fu Dog]] (from ''[[disney:American Dragon: Jake Long|American Dragon: Jake Long]]'') visit the island to check out reports that magical creatures (actually [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s experiments) are running rampant. While Jake, Trixie, Spud and Fu investigate, Lao Shi goes on a date with [[Mrs. Hasagawa]], and Jake becomes late to the skateboarding contest after Gantu captures him in his dragon form, mistaking him for the shapeshifting experiment. Lilo disguises herself as Jake Long's human form after Jake's capture and subsequent escape.

Mr. Stenchy (episode).plot:
[[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] rescue [[Mr. Stenchy (254)|an irresistibly cute experiment]] from [[Gantu]]. While at a gas station filling up the buggy, Lilo notices [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]], [[Elena]], [[Teresa]], and [[Yuki]] walking by. Lilo shows them the experiment, and the girls coo at how adorable he is. Mertle then decides to invite Lilo to her FHGH (Future Hawaiian Girls of Hawaii) tea party if she brings the experiment along. Lilo happily agrees and decides to keep the experiment, but Stitch isn't too pleased about that.

Lilo and Stitch take the experiment [[Lilo's House|home]] and [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] explains his function. The experiment is a walking stink bomb. He is cute and friendly in order to easily infiltrate an enemy's home or base. Then, 42 hours after being activated, he releases a noxious odor that will leave the area uninhabitable for decades. Despite this, Lilo names him Mr. Stenchy, and wants to keep him. But, Jumba tells her to not get attached, as he has to send Mr. Stenchy into space so no one will smell him.  Lilo protests this, saying she needs to bring him to the tea party. Jumba reluctantly allows her to keep him for 24 hours. 

At the backyard tea party, Stitch spies on the group through the fence. Lilo and the other girls dote on Mr. Stenchy and give him muffins. Stitch gets jealous of the attention Mr. Stenchy is getting, and decides to crash the party. After he eats all the food, Mertle yells at Lilo to leave Stitch at home for tomorrow's tea party. Later, Lilo, [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]], Jumba, and [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] go to the store. Lilo asks Stitch to watch Mr. Stenchy while they are gone. Stitch agrees, but as soon as everyone else has left, he shuts Mr. Stenchy into the pantry (without hurting him). Stitch tries relaxing with soda after that, but [[Gantu]] arrives to steal Mr. Stenchy. After a brief fight, Stitch disarms Gantu. Gantu tells Stitch that eventually he'll take an experiment away forever. This gives Stitch an idea, and he "accidentally" loses Gantu's blaster. He then leads Gantu toward the pantry, and allows Mr. Stenchy to be captured. 

Later, when everyone gets home, Lilo asks what happened, and why the house is a wreck. Stitch gives his version of events, and Jumba points out that Mr. Stenchy is likely already being sent to [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]], Lilo is saddened by this. At Gantu's ship, he prepares to teleport Mr. Stenchy to Hämsterviel. But, Gantu then develops an affection for the cute experiment, making [[Reuben (625)|625]] jealous as well. Gantu decides to keep Mr. Stenchy for a while.

The next day, Lilo is depressed. She tells Nani that her "friends" won't want her to come to the tea party without Mr. Stenchy. Nani says that if the other girls were true friends, they would like her regardless of how cute her pet is. She adds that Stitch is a true friend to Lilo because he is loyal and would never hurt her. Lilo agrees, and Stitch can't help but feel guilty for his actions. Later, Lilo goes to the tea party anyway to explain what happened. However, Mertle points out that "Mr. Stenchy" is already there. Stitch has decided to make himself a Mr. Stenchy costume, and tries to blend in. Although it went well at first, Stitch enjoyed himself too much and eventually the other girls realize the truth. Mertle accidentally breaks a window and then tries shooing Stitch away with a broom. This eventually leads to part of her home's patio being destroyed. Worried about her mother grounding her, Mertle kicks Lilo out of her backyard, and the FHGH permanently. 

Later that evening, Lilo talks to Stitch. She blames herself for letting Gantu take Mr. Stenchy, and laments that he will never find his one true place. However, she says she's glad to have someone like Stitch as a friend, this make Stitch feel even worse. He then uses the computer to pull up a schematic of Gantu's ship, planning to break in. Meanwhile, Gantu is doting on Mr. Stenchy, even making a little bed for him. 625 expresses his displeasure, but denies that he is jealous. 625 leaves for "some air", but at that moment, Stitch breaks in and attacks him. Gantu quickly captures Stitch, then puts him on the teleporter, planning to send him to a barren asteroid. Mr. Stenchy enters and gives Gantu a sandwich. Gantu declares it is the best sandwich he had ever eaten, and this upsets 625. Stitch discreetly tells 625 to help him escape, so he can take Mr. Stenchy away.

A few minutes later, Gantu has decided on a place to send Stitch, but finds that 625 is in the teleporter. While 625 distracts him, Stitch pounces and forces Gantu into a locked room. He grabs Mr. Stenchy, and tries to leave, but Gantu escapes the room, and traps Stitch in a net. At that moment, Jumba, Pleakley, and Lilo arrive to help, and subdue Gantu with sticky webbing. Mr. Stenchy is left to decide who he wants to go with. Gantu tries beckoning him over, as do Lilo and Stitch. But, Mr. Stenchy runs away from Stitch, remembering how poorly he was treated. Lilo questions this, and Gantu reveals that Stitch locked Mr. Stenchy in the pantry. Stitch admits that he did because he felt jealous. Lilo offers to forgive him for his actions, as long as he forgives her for paying more attention to Mr. Stenchy. The pair make up, but Mr. Stenchy still goes to Gantu's side. However, a foul smell fills the air as he goes to hug Gantu. Mr. Stenchy's power activates, and disgusts everyone (except Pleakley, who likens the odor to a rare and valuable perfume from his home planet.) Gantu quickly gives Mr. Stenchy to Lilo and her friends.

Later, Jumba loads Mr. Stenchy into a mini rocket attached to the buggy, and it blasts off into space. Pleakley worries that Mr. Stenchy will be all alone, but Jumba reassures him that the experiment will go somewhere that everyone will love him. Mr. Stenchy's ship lands on [[Plorgonar]], and is immediately found by a Plorgonarian couple. Not only do they think Mr. Stenchy is cute, he smells like their first date. Mr. Stenchy is happy to be in his new home.

Mrs. Hasagawa's Cats.plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] try to help [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] out by organizing her [[Hasagawa Fruits|fruit stand]] and cleaning her yard. However, when she tries to offer them a bowl of apricots for their help, they discover that the bowl is actually full of [[Experiment Pods|experiment pods]], and [[Mrs. Hasagawa's House|her house]] is later full of stray experiments, which she believes are "cats". Lilo and Stitch try to gather all the experiments, but it turns out that Mrs. Hasagawa has taken a liking to them and tamed them herself, so the experiments won't need to be captured after all.

Nosy (episode).plot:
[[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] is having an interview at the [[Birds of Paradise Hotel|hotel]]'s rental pavilion. [[Mr. Jameson|Her prospective boss]] lets her know that his business is known for its "aloha hospitality." He adds that part of the job requires her to help with the hotel's brunches. Nani says she can do that since she often does brunches for her own family. Mr. Jameson then invites himself, and his son, [[Keoni Jameson|Keoni]], over to the [[Lilo's House|Pelekais' home]] for brunch to demonstrate the spirit of "aloha hospitality".

At the house, [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] is working on the garden, when he is suddenly hit with a balloon filled with poi. [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] are running around the house, having a poi balloon fight, getting the whole kitchen messy. Pleakley tries to join in, but ends up hitting Nani, who was just entering the room. She explains the situation with Mr. Jameson and that she wants to make a good impression. Lilo agrees, since she has a massive crush on Keoni. But, she and Stitch try to leave, wanting to catch a movie while Nani does all the work. But, Nani orders everyone to help her clean the poi. Much later, Lilo and Stitch manage to make it to the movie theater. They notice [[Nosy (199)|someone with a big nose]] approaching, and try to avoid hearing spoilers from the movie. But, he reveals the twist ending before they can cover their ears. Stitch grabs the blabbermouth, removing his disguise and revealing him as an experiment.

Back at home, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] explains that the experiment, 199, is designed to snoop around and dig up dirt on the enemy. 199 demonstrates by revealing that Stitch had "borrowed" one of Lilo's favorite books. Lilo decides to name the experiment "Nosy," but says they should hide him so he won't bother anyone during the brunch the following morning. A bit later, Pleakley decides to put Lilo, Stitch, and Jumba through etiquette boot camp based on lessons from the "Helen the Hostess" show. This goes poorly, not only due to Jumba and Stitch having bad manners in general, but Pleakley not fully knowing proper table manners himself.
