Stitch's bad etiquette leads him to ban Stitch from sitting at the table.

The next day, everyone is getting dressed for the brunch and making last minute adjustments while Nani runs to the store to get more ingredients. When Nani gets back, she panics because Pleakley was supposed to have started with the food already. Pleakley tries reassuring her that he has a Yule log in the oven, having seen it on a rerun of Helen the Hostess. But, before Nani can correct him on what the purpose of the Yule log is, there's a knock at the door. Mr. Jameson and Keoni have come over early to help with cooking the brunch as a show of "aloha hospitality." Nani invites the Jamesons in and introduces them to her family. But at that moment, Nosy, back in his human disguise, makes his way out into the living room, and begins blurting out that there are aliens in the house, including himself. He then notices Keoni, and addresses him. Stitch starts carrying Nosy away, but he reveals that Lilo has a crush on Keoni. Stitch manages to get him upstairs and into an experiment capsule before he says anything else to the group.

Afterwards, Mr. Jameson asks who the big nosed guy was. Pleakley says that it was "Wacky Uncle Jared" who was visiting. Nani then asks Lilo to come to the kitchen to help. Nani is on edge, not only because of Nosy, but because Jumba is cooking with thermonuclear technology, causing a ham to glow green. Lilo reassures Nani that Nosy is locked upstairs and won't be disturbing anyone anymore. Nani is relieved, but reiterates that she really wants Mr. Jameson to hire her, so everything else must go smoothly. She leaves to check something, but Jumba tells Lilo that Nosy is a master escape artist in addition to being a master snoop. Lilo tells Stitch to quickly get rid of Nosy before he escapes and messes anything else up. 

Stitch stuffs Nosy into a gift box, then makes his way to [[Gantu's Ship|Gantu's ship]]. Stitch gives the gift box to [[Gantu]], then promptly leaves. Gantu, who had been searching for Nosy for several days at that point, is happy about this development. But, he soon gets annoyed when Nosy reveals embarrassing gossip rather than information about other active experiments. Gantu gets fed up and sends Nosy to [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]]. Hämsterviel then asks Nosy what Gantu and [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] say about him. Nosy reveals that they have many unflattering nicknames for him, like "Ratface" and "Keister-viel." Hämsterviel gets angry, then sends Nosy back to Gantu, hoping Nosy will annoy him more. But, when Nosy arrives, he shows Gantu and Reuben that he swiped Hämsterviel's journal. Gantu takes the journal to read, then tells Reuben to get rid of Nosy. Reuben goes to bring Nosy back to Lilo's house. But, Hämsterviel calls Gantu, informs him that Nosy stole his journal, and that Gantu must bring Nosy back and keep him in the ship, or be fired.

Meanwhile, at the Pelekai house, everyone is playing games outside while Nani finishes cooking. Keoni asks Lilo what "Uncle Jared" meant about her crush on him. Lilo says that "Uncle Jared" is a compulsive liar thanks to a disease. While everyone else plays badminton, Lilo and Stitch head inside to think of a way to ease Keoni's suspicions about Lilo's crush. Nani asks for Lilo to help her get brunch on the table outside, but Lilo says that she needs to come up with a plan to keep her secret. Nani agrees to tell her how to keep her secret in exchange for helping to finish getting ready. Once the food is plated and served, Lilo then enters with Stitch wearing a disguise. Nani says that Lilo brought her boyfriend "Kenny" over to have brunch with them. Keoni is a little surprised, but Lilo says that "Uncle Jared" got the names Keoni and Kenny confused. She then adds that "Uncle Jared" went back to Saskatchewan. 

Mr. Jameson tells Nani that he has now realized something about her and her family. He concludes that since "Uncle Jared" is from Canada, when "aliens" were mentioned, he meant "people from another country." He adds that Nani's multicultural family must be where she gets her "aloha hospitality" from. At that moment, Nosy comes in, saying he's got some stories to tell. Stitch tries to stop Nosy from reaching the table by tackling him. But, Mr. Jameson pulls Stitch off, messing up the "Kenny" disguise. Mr. Jameson and Keoni are stunned, and are further stunned when Nosy continues to blab on about how he and Stitch are genetic experiments, how Nani thinks Mr. Jameson is a snob, and how Pleakley isn't a woman. After Pleakley runs into the house in embarrassment, Nani tries to explain what is happening. Before she can, Gantu enters the backyard, demanding Nosy back. Lilo and Stitch give him up willingly, and Gantu leaves. Nani is positive that all this strangeness cost her the job. But, Mr. Jameson decides to extend the job offer to her, saying that only someone with amazing hospitality skills would welcome such strange people into her family. Keoni talks to Lilo, saying that its probably a good thing his crush on Aunt Pleakley only last about a week, considering what he just heard. He adds that kids' crushes come and go quickly, and Lilo has likely gotten over her crush on him already. Lilo agrees, but gives a knowing smile, glad that her secret is somewhat safe.

In the end, Nosy returns to Gantu's ship and gossips about Gantu to Reuben, much to Reuben's joy and Gantu's anger.

PJ (episode).plot: When [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] is blamed for pranking her strict substitute hula teacher, she decides to use [[PJ (133)|a practical-jokester experiment]] to get revenge and impress [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]]. However, things don't go well for Lilo when [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] interferes with their plans. Now, PJ has set up the ultimate prank, and Stitch must stop them before the jokes go too far.

Phantasmo (episode).plot:
[[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], and their family enjoy dinner and games at [[Macki Macaw's]] until the animatronic bird falls off its perch and burns up. [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] are oddly impressed by the lackluster performance. Despite the technical failure, Lilo enjoys the restaurant and wishes she could come more often. Lilo and Stitch play the claw game with Stitch's only quarter and are able to pull in an oyster. The machine holds onto the prize and Stitch shakes it until the trinket is released. [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] scolds the alien, but the employee allows them to keep it and leave.

Back at [[Lilo's House|her house]], Lilo must give Stitch a bath, but when Nani says the "b-word", Stitch flees from the tub. Stitch attempts to take refuge in Jumba's room, but Lilo easily discovers his hiding spot. She drags him to the bathroom and splashes him into the water. As she does so, the oyster shell, which contains a yellow experiment pod, is washed away into the hallway. [[Phantasmo (375)|Experiment 375]] is washed into a corner and activated. Resembling a ghost, 375 begins causing trouble by entering objects, creating a mess in the kitchen.

Stitch rushes to the sounds in the kitchen, but after he catches Pleakley's dishes, the experiment causes him to fall, shattering them. Nani angrily sends Stitch to his room, but Lilo believes Stitch is telling the truth in his innocence. Nani says it's bedtime and they will discuss it the next day.

During the night, the ghost experiment sneaks into Lilo's room and enters her doll [[Scrump]]. Stitch follows Scrump out of the room into the living the room, but after finding nothing, he attempts to return to the room, only to be hit by the elevator platform.

A loud scream sets the morning into motion. Nani's face has been painted green, Jumba's experiment analyzer has been tampered with, and Pleakley's plant has gone missing. Lilo comes downstairs wondering where Stitch is. He is found in the living room holding a paintbrush in one hand and Pleakley's begonia in the other hand. Lilo believes her pet is innocent until she sees her broken record player nearby. A picture on the ground also displays Stitch scratching his foot with Nani's purple toothbrush, infuriating Nani more. She angrily tosses him outside, and orders that he cannot come inside until she returns home. As Lilo closes the door, Scrump laughs at Stitch's misfortune.

Lilo creates a cardboard doghouse for Stitch before she has to chain him to a tree. She warns him that he must be on his best behavior.

Inside, Lilo begins an [[wikipedia:Elvis Presley|Elvis]] movie marathon with Scrump. Through the window, Stitch notices Scrump messing with Lilo's movies. He detaches his chain and charges in to attack the doll. Lilo believes Stitch is trying to tear apart her movies, and, as he attacks Scrump once more, Jumba nets 626. Lilo still holds out hope that her alien is innocent and deserves a fair trial.

Jumba begins acting as judge and Pleakley attempts to prosecute Stitch. He gives the evidence for Stitch's guilt, but Lilo still claims 626 is not guilty. She questions Stitch whether he did any of the "crimes", but he replies he can only remember sleeping the whole time. Pleakley uses Stitch's violence towards Lilo's stuffed animals as incriminating evidence, and Scrump gives a sly look towards Stitch. He attacks the doll, just as Nani returns home. Jumba believes perhaps Stitch is reverting to his evil ways.

Jumba puts Stitch in a machine to scan him for evil qualities. He is left alone there, but as he examines the photograph, he sees Scrump in a mirror reflection, taking the picture.

Jumba and Pleakley watch an Elvis movie, but Lilo notices that her rag doll has gone missing. She finds it in Jumba's room, destroying Pleakley's plant. Experiment 375 exits Scrump and enters into a length of rope. He uses it to tie up Lilo, Jumba, and Pleakley, leaving them trapped. Jumba recognizes him, but the experiment soon reenters Scrump and holds a gun towards them. Soon, however, Stitch climbs through the window to free his family and find 375.

As they search downstairs, Pleakley attempts to hide upstairs, but his way is cut off by a vacuum cleaner controlled by Phantasmo. Stitch is unable to [[Net Cannon|net]] 375 and Lilo is not able to trap him in a [[Prison Capsule|capsule]], because Phantasmo can phase through objects. They pursue him through [[Kokaua Town|town]], but are still unable to catch him. He soon begins chasing them in [[X-Buggy|the buggy]], but Nani picks Lilo and Stitch up in her jeep. The experiment chases them, but Lilo finally discovers that Phantasmo craves attention. Lilo begs Nani to lead him to the pizza restaurant, Macki Macaw's.

They lead him inside and he traps Stitch in the claw machine. Lilo is chased backstage by him, and he enters the broken animatronic. Lilo opens the curtains and when Phantasmo realizes he has an audience, he begins putting on a show. Nani apologizes to Stitch for counting him guilty. They promise to forgive her as long as she buys games and pizza. 375 happily rocks out and is pleased that he has all eyes on him.

Phoon (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] temporarily quits experiment hunting to try and get accepted into [[Hip Hop Fusion Studio|Hula Hip Hop Fusion school]], where she impresses some hippie girls by telling them that she is filthy rich and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] is a rare animal. Meanwhile, [[Phoon (540)|a small, typhoon-creating experiment]] is unleashed, causing [[Gantu]] to take a bad blow to the head. Lilo tricks Gantu into thinking that [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] and [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] are just figments of his imagination, and [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s [[Plasmatic Englobulatron|new device]] causes Phoon to mutate into a giant monster.

Ploot (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] tries to clean [[Pudge]]'s grotto for Earth Day, but meets [[Ploot (505)|an experiment that eats trash and later redistributes it across the island as pollutant goo]]. When [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] gets sick from eating trash, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] have to find a way to cure him, and Lilo must find a way to stop Ploot by herself. She tries enlisting other experiments to help (first [[Kixx (601)|Kixx]], [[Deforestator (515)|Deforestator]] and [[Richter (513)|Richter]]; later [[Finder (158)|Finder]], [[Babyfier (151)|Babyfier]] and [[Drowsy (360)|Drowsy]]), but Ploot is too powerful for them. Eventually, Stitch is cured and thanks to Pleakley, a way to defeat Ploot is found through a combination of air fresheners. With help from Stitch, Lilo defeats Ploot herself, and he becomes good and sets to work at cleaning up trash and pollution rather than making it.

Poxy (episode).plot:
An [[Experiment Pods|experiment pod]] ends up in a box of sugar, which is bought by the Pelekais. [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] unknowingly adds the pod to his cereal and shallows it as begins to activate. Its activation alerts [[Gantu]], so he suits up to capture the experiment. Meanwhile, while [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] and [[David Kawena|David]] are getting ready to go wave riding, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] are playing with the water scooters when they accidentally break one. Lilo wants to go wave riding as well, only to be told she is not old enough.

When they arrive home, they find Pleakley lying on the couch feeling sick. He is covered in purple pimples, has a swollen eye, his feet stink and is burping uncontrollably. Lilo and Stitch try to help curing him, but then he runs away to the clinic after Stitch tries to perform surgery on him with a chainsaw. Lilo and Stitch tell [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] about Pleakley's symptoms, who identifies this to be the work of [[Poxy (222)|Experiment 222]]: designed to act as a virus and infect popular planetary leaders, giving them purple pimples, smelly feet, swollen eyes, and uncontrollable burping.

At the clinic, Gantu is looking for Pleakley, who has just arrived. He tries to capture him, but he runs. Later, Lilo and Stitch show up in time to save him and tell him about the experiment infecting his body. After escaping Gantu and returning [[Lilo's House|home]], Jumba [[Reducer Ray|shrinks]] Lilo and Stitch, along with the [[X-Buggy]], to microscopic size and injects them into Pleakley's body so they can search and capture Experiment 222. Once inside, Lilo and Stitch find themselves travelling through Pleakley's blood. They soon spot 222, and chase after him. However, they fall under attack by one of Pleakley's antibodies. Using some wave riding maneuvers, Lilo manages to shake of the pursuing antibodies. However, they end up passing through Pleakley's hearts. Meanwhile, Gantu shows up and takes Pleakley. Jumba tries to stop him, but Gantu easily overpowers him. He even breaks [[Jumba's Computer]], losing contact with Lilo and Stitch.

Gantu takes Pleakley to [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]] and prepares him for molecular transport to [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Dr. Hämsterviel]]. Meanwhile, unaware of what is happening, Lilo and Stitch find themselves inside Pleakley's stomach and spot 222. The chase is on once again. They chase him through lung trees and make their way to the eyeball. Stitch deploys the capture cannon and tries to capture 222. He misses and the grapple ends up grabbing the optic disc, which Pleakley reacts to in pain. Lilo and Stitch try the grapple again, but this time, 222 catches it and rips of the capture cannon. At the same time, Lilo and Stitch realize that Pleakley has been captured by Gantu and that he is about to be transported to Hämsterviel. So, they head for Pleakley's brain, where Stitch wires himself to Pleakley's nerves. Connected to his brain, Stitch controls Pleakley's body, helping him escape the containment unit and tries to battle Gantu. Just then, Jumba shows up and shrinks Gantu. Then he turns to Pleakley and calls out to Lilo and Stitch that they need to leave his body immediately. He had been trying to tell them that the shrinking process only lasts for an hour and it was about to wear off. If they start to grow while still inside Pleakley's body, he will explode.

Lilo and Stitch hurry to the nearest exit, which is the ear. Also, 222 is heading in the same direction, so they pursue him. They make one last effort to capture 222. He ends up getting stuck in the earwax, giving Lilo and Stitch the chance to capture him. Suddenly, they start growing back to normal size and they quickly hurry to the mouth. Pleakley burps them out just as they grow back to normal size. With Experiment 222 removed from his body, Pleakley returns to normal.

Afterwards, Lilo has come to learn that being little is not such a bad thing. As for Experiment 222, Lilo planted him inside Gantu, who falls sick with the same symptoms Pleakley had. Now he is miserable with itchy purple pimples, uncontrollable burping, a swollen red right eye, and stinky feet, despite the fact he wanted to capture the experiment.

Remmy (episode).plot:
It is the anniversary of when [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]]'s [[Mr. and Mrs. Pelekai|parents]] passed away. They both feel very depressed, especially Lilo. She takes a nap to deal with her sadness while her sister goes for a long, silent walk to deal with her own sadness and, at the same time, tries to find a way to make Lilo and herself feel better. However, recently activated [[Remmy (276)|Experiment 276]], designed to invade people's dreams and transform them into nightmares, shows up at [[Lilo's House|their house]]. [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]] search the house, making sure nobody is asleep. They find [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] awake, but find Lilo asleep, and witness 276 enter her dream. Jumba warns Pleakley not to wake Lilo because if she regains consciousness while 276 is still inside her dream, the experiment will remain inside her mind forever, turning all future dreams into nightmares. The only thing they can do is enter Lilo's dream and capture 276 before she wakes up. To accomplish this, Jumba recommends using a failed nuclear powered spatula that he fashioned for Nani, which happens to work as a teleportation device, making it possible to transport beings into dreams.

Jumba, Pleakley, and Stitch gather together in Lilo's room with the spatula and a vacuum device for capturing 276. After giving everyone a word of caution about the dreamworld, Jumba activates the spatula which transports them into Lilo's dream. They find themselves in Lilo's room, and see nothing unusual to confirm they are inside her dream. But then they see Lilo walking on the ceiling and having a party with two zombies, confirming they are inside her dream. Suddenly, 276 starts to invade Lilo's dream by dissolving her zombies and her room. After the floor dissolves beneath their feet the four them fall from black void before landing in the middle of a dream [[Kokaua Town]]. Walking around, they meet a dream [[Mrs. Hasagawa]] who's head turns into a crab. Then they spot 276 flying around, dissolving everything in sight. The four of them try to capture him using the vacuum, but 276 jams the nozzle with a dream fire hydrant. Then he continues to dissolve the dream Kokaua Town to nothing but a black void. Lilo, Stitch, Jumba and Pleakley run till they reach a dead end. However, they spot a door on the other side of the void. Lilo is afraid of this door because bad things happen behind it. She wishes to stay behind, but Stitch insists on her coming. To get to the door, Lilo dreams up dental floss to use as rope. They all make to the door just as 276 completely dissolves the rest of Lilo's dream.

Lilo, Stitch, Jumba and Pleakley find themselves in Lilo's [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]]. In this dream, Lilo's hula classmates are all nice to her, all the [[experiments]] are behaving and dancing with a dream Pleakley, a dream Jumba is flying above their heads in a tuxedo, and Lilo is president of the universe. [[Gantu]] and [[Reuben|625]] are also in Lilo's dream. The four of them almost forget about Experiment 276, and because this is a good dream he is sure to invade it. Pretty soon, 276 shows up and starts turning Lilo's dream into a nightmare. He turns the dream experiments into bats and turns the dream Ganti and Lilo's classmates against her. Things get worse when Nani returns home from her walk and tries to wake up Lilo. Jumba sends Pleakley back to stop her, otherwise they will be trapped inside Lilo's dream forever.

Pleakley explains to Nani about the experiment in Lilo's dream, and that Stitch and Jumba are inside trying to capture it. Lilo is starting to slowly wake up, but Nani manages to put her back to sleep with a song their mother used to sing to them. Inside Lilo's dream, 276 has completely turned her dream into a nightmarish world where everyone is out to get her. Nani and Pleakley notice this too as she twists and turns in her bed. Then Nani notices their old family picture. She gives it to Pleakley and tells him to go back into her dream and give it to her. She believes it will help her overcome her miseries and possibly turn her nightmares back into dreams. Though reluctant, Pleakley teleport himself back into Lilo's dream. The four of them find themselves cornered by monster versions of Lilo's classmates and a giant Gantu. Pleakley remember the picture and gives it to Lilo. This helps her remember the happy times, which instantly turns the nightmarish surroundings into a peaceful dream of her with her sister and parents having a picnic on the beach. This defeats 276 and he is captured. Stitch, Jumba and Pleakley exit Lilo's dream with 276 just before she wakes up, feeling a lot happier than before.

Afterwards, Jumba gives 276 a reprogramming and finds his one true place as a virtual reality game at the local arcade. Meanwhile, Lilo, Stitch and Nani have a picnic on the beach with [[David Kawena|David]].

Retro (episode).plot: [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]]'s middle school friends, [[Ellen and Lona]], return to [[Kauai]] for a visit and, thinking that Nani is vice president of the business she works for (which is clearly not true), invite her and her ''ʻohana'' on a yacht cruise. Meanwhile, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] encounters [[Retro (210)|an experiment that reverts individuals to a primitive state]]. [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Pleakley]], Ellen and Lona are transformed into cave people, which causes trouble on the yacht. Now, Stitch must find and capture Retro before it's too late.

Richter (episode).plot:
While two men relax on a beach, one points out that the ice in their cooler has already melted, when a blue pod marked "513" falls into the water. The [[Richter (513)|newly-released experiment]] slams his tail into the ground, causing rocks to split and the ground to shake.

While working on his [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]], [[Gantu]] orders [[Reuben (625)|625]] to turn off the news, which is alerting them of the earthquakes. Reuben tells Gantu that he will be prepared in case of emergency because he has been stockpiling sandwiches. [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Dr. Hämsterviel]] sends a transmission to Gantu, exclaiming that instead of results, Gantu only gives disappointment. Hämsterviel tells his lackey to bring an experiment at once. Soon Gantu is alerted about Experiment 513, and he leaves prepared to catch him.

[[Pleakley]] attempts to prepare [[Lilo]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], and [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] for further quakes, telling them not to panic, but he soon begins panicking. Stitch calms him down by pouring water on him, and Pleakley presents "Earthquake Preparation Kits". [[David Kawena]] comes by the house to tell [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] that her boss has requested her to come to work, although it is her day off.

At the [[Rental Hut|beach shack]], [[Mr. Wong]] is happy that the milkshake machine is unharmed by the earthquakes, but Nani expresses her distaste in having to work on her day off. While Stitch is helping clean the shack, he rides on a scuba tank, which smashes into the shake machine. Stitch attempts to repair it, but it is irreparable. Stitch takes the orange orb from the top of the machine and tries to eat it. Lilo snatches it away and tells Stitch he must care for things he likes. Stitch then cuddles the orange ball as if it were a kitten. Nearby on the beach, Gantu questions a couple about any anomalies they've seen since the quakes. Lilo realizes the seismic activity is likely due to an experiment.

Back at [[Lilo's House|her house]], Lilo consults Jumba and the [[Jumba's Computer|computer]] about the experiment. Jumba warns them that 513 will find the spot on the island that will cause the biggest earthquake, and that they should stop him before he goes below ground. He equips them with a gel pack that will immobilize the experiment in a sticky mess. Pleakley enters to perform an earthquake drill: duck, cover, scream.

Lilo and Stitch trail 513 but when they confront him, he smacks the ground, causing the duo to fall over. Gantu rushes the experiment, hoping to blast him with a net, but in his holster is a sandwich. 513 flees underground, much to Lilo and Stitch's chagrin. Gantu attempts to follow 513, but has to fight Stitch. Stitch is disarmed, making Gantu believe he has the upper hand, but Lilo tosses the sticky blaster and Stitch encases the giant shark-like alien in it.

They enter the caves and are closed in by falling rocks. They locate Experiment 513, who keeps evading Stitch's shots. He tosses them from the cave and causes more rocks to collapse, blocking Lilo and Stitch's way. Stitch quickly checks on his orange ball, to ensure it is intact.

Jumba modifies [[X-Buggy|Nani's buggy]] to include an industrial drill on the front but notices Stitch's ball. He is perplexed that Stitch is caring for something. After Pleakley panics more, Lilo and Stitch return to the previous rocky location. Gantu has just freed himself from the goo, when he realizes his experiment containment pod is loaded with sandwiches. 626 drills into the side of the rock, unaware that Gantu is following behind them. They locate 513 the source of the shaking, but he takes Stitch's ball. Soon the ledge crumbles beneath the car. Stitch must decide between saving Lilo or his ball.

He is able to catch Lilo and corner 513, but before retrieving his ball, Gantu captures the alien in the containment tube. Stitch tries once to free his cousin but is not fast enough. Gantu blasts the car to prevent it from moving and abandons them in the caverns. As more rocks fall, Stitch hot-wires the car, allowing it to start.

The two return to the earth's surface outside a gas station where Jumba and Pleakley are buying more supplies. Jumba is still unable to understand why Stitch cares for the orb so much, but again the island is shaking. He is able to determine that Experiment 513 has begun a chain reaction which will soon tear the island apart. If another crack can be created at a right angle to the first crack, the quakes will stop.

They quickly rush to Gantu's ship to rescue 513, who has just been placed in the transport chamber. Stitch fights Gantu, as Lilo randomly presses buttons. The countdown to teleportation begins, but Stitch causes Gantu to smash the chamber walls and land on the pad. Experiment 513 is able to escape, but Gantu is teleported instead, much to Hämsterviel's annoyance. Using items from the earthquake kit, Lilo ties up 513.

At the ideal location for the opposing crack, Experiment 513 refuses to help until Stitch offers the orange ball. Lilo names him Richter and after releasing him, he rushes underground to create the crack to save the island. Stitch digs into the ground to retrieve his cousin and gives him the ball, which he earned. Lilo then introduces him to his one true place: the beach shack as the new milkshake mixer.

Rufus (episode).plot:
[[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] is running through trees while trying to hide as [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] had finished counting. While looking around to find Stitch, she eventually finds him in the palm tree. Lilo is not pleased by this, as Stitch was supposed to hide instead of telling her where he is, thus defeating the purpose of hide-and-seek. Suddenly, an aircraft has abducted Stitch from the tree, and Lilo goes after it but soon loses it.

Back at [[Lilo's House|her house]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] finds [[Pleakley]] in the living room looking at some magazines, which he refers to them as his "treasure of Earth knowledge." Lilo soon returns back home and tells them of Stitch's disappearance. She then suggests using [[Jumba's Ship|Jumba's ship]] to find him. Jumba tells her that his ship is not working, so Lilo decides to rescue Stitch on her own. Jumba warns her that she cannot go on dangerous missions without 626.

Lilo wonders who could do the job better than her, until Pleakley finds a magazine cover of [[Kim Possible]]. He then tells Lilo that they can go to Kim's website, tell her that they are in trouble, and take advantage of her highly efficient secret agent skills. Jumba then looks at the magazine which soon intrigues him, regarding Kim's impressive resume. Lilo is pessimistic about having to hire Kim and claims she does not need her, as they can do the job themselves. However, Pleakley assures Lilo that the "saving business" should be left to the professionals, as he soon writes an e-mail to Kim reading: "ATTENTION! URGENT MATTER, SAFETY OF THE WORLD AT STAKE, NEED HELP A.S.A.P." and sends the letter. Pleakley then says that they will have to wait for Kim to arrive, though Lilo is worried if Stitch needs them right now.

When Kim Possible, [[Ron Stoppable]], and [[Rufus]] arrive to help Lilo save Stitch (after learning that the world is not in danger), Lilo tries to brush Kim off, as she wants to save Stitch on her own. However, Jumba notices Ron's pet naked mole rat. He mistakes Rufus for Experiment 607 ([[Experiments#6-Series: Battlefield and doomsday experiments with galactic implications|Launch]]) and chases him for most of the adventure, much to Ron's horror. Lilo and Kim decide to team up to rescue Stitch.

Meanwhile, [[Dr. Drakken]] and [[Shego]] have Stitch confined inside an [[Underwater Base|underwater base]], where they both prepare to clone him. When Kim goes out to find the base and rescue Stitch, she gets sucked into a current ("People Eater") and is also taken hostage. Eventually, Stitch and Kim are rescued from their prison by Lilo and Rufus. Everyone then manages to escape the underwater base.

Back on [[Lahui Beach|the beach]], Jumba is still convinced that Rufus is Experiment 607. However, Stitch takes Ron's pet naked mole rat, sniffs him a few times, and reveals to Jumba that Rufus is not one of his "cousins" but a mole rat, much to Jumba's surprise. Later, Lilo teaches Kim how to dance the hula, and everyone has a good time together.

Sample (episode).plot:
[[Pleakley]] gathers the day's mail at the Pelekai house. [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], and [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] gather around while Pleakley doles out the envelopes. There's one addressed to Stitch; a reminder from the animal shelter for Stitch to get his shots. Stitch runs away, and Lilo gives chase. Stitch climbs onto the rooftop dome to get away from Lilo, refusing to get the shots. Lilo promises that he can have coconut cake and coffee for breakfast as long as they go to the shelter afterwards, and Stitch agrees. Meanwhile, Pleakley reads through the mail, and stumbles across a flyer for an upcoming alien convention. He is excited about the possibility of meeting other aliens.

Later, on a [[Golf Course|golf course]], a pair of golfers drive their cart across the green, looking for where their ball went. One of the men sees a white experiment pod and hits it into a water hazard. [[Sample (258)|The experiment inside activates and takes in his surroundings]]. A bird squawks next to him and, using his speaker-like ears, he repeats the noise a few times. A nearby frog croaks, and the experiment repeats that sound, making a rhythm from the noises. He dances around to his beat, but the golfers get annoyed and cover their ears.

On [[Gantu's Ship|Gantu's ship]], [[Gantu]] is meditating while listening to a motivational CD. He is interrupted by the computer's experiment activation alert. It says the experiment's function is to annoy the populace by sampling and repeating sounds in an endless rhythm. Inspired by the CD, Gantu tells [[Reuben (625)|625]] to not let him back into the ship unless he has successfully captured Experiment 258.

Out in [[Kokaua Town|town]], the experiment is running amok, taking in all the new sounds it hears, and adding them to its rhythm. People run away from the noise. Gantu is following closely behind, repeating phrases from his CD. But before he can grab the experiment, a dogcatcher scoops up 258 and takes him to the [[Aloha Animal Rescue|animal shelter]]. The shelter's manager, [[Susan Hegarty|Susan]], looks at the "weird dog", and calls a number on her recently acquired Alien Convention flyer.

A bit later, two young men, [[Merwin and Dean]], enter the shelter, and ask to see the creature. They tell Susan that they are alien hunters, and are preparing to go to the upcoming convention by dressing as aliens and holding prop weapons. The pair get a good look at 258. Merwin is excited and declares they will bring the experiment to the convention and show it to everyone. Dean is doubtful, since they tried the same thing last year with an ostrich. Merwin says this year will be different, because the creature before them is clearly an alien. 

At that same time, Lilo is dragging Stitch into the shelter, assuring him that he will be okay inside. The alien hunters see Stitch, realize he is an alien as well, and make a grab for him. Stitch fends off Dean, then takes the experiment away from Merwin. He and Lilo escape with 258, and the hunters chase them. Lilo tells 258 to be quiet so they aren't followed, but 258 can't stop sampling. Nearby, Gantu is alerted to the noise, and heads towards it. The hunters follow the sound as well, but Lilo and Stitch hide amongst some tiki statues. The hunters pause by the tikis and comment on them, but press onward. 258 adds those words to his rhythm, and alerts the hunters again. But, Gantu arrives to the scene as well. Merwin says they should forget about grabbing the experiments and take the much larger Gantu with them instead. Lilo, Stitch, and 258 escape while their backs are turned. Gantu tries to give chase, but notices the prop weapon Dean is holding. Apparently, it looks like the most feared plasma cannon in the galaxy. Gantu retreats back to his ship. He pounds on the hatch, yelling for 625 to let him inside. 625 pokes his head outside, and says that he is following Gantu's order from earlier: No matter how much he begs, do not let him inside the ship unless he has 258. Gantu has no other choice but to run somewhere else.

Meanwhile, Lilo and Stitch have returned [[Lilo's House|home]] with the experiment. Jumba explains the experiment's function, and Lilo decides to name him Sample. Stitch quickly gets annoyed with Sample's rhythm, and throws him into a closet. Pleakley then comes downstairs, dressed in his old Galactic Federation uniform. He says he is heading off to the convention, but Jumba stops him. He says that an alien convention is sure to draw the attention of alien hunters and spies. Jumba quickly puts on a wig and goes with Pleakley to the convention. As soon as they leave the house, Gantu runs up to the porch and pounds on the door. Lilo goes to open it, and Gantu forces his way in, begging for a place to hide. Stitch sees Merwin and Dean approaching. Lilo makes Gantu promise that he won't take Sample once they help him hide. Lilo and Stitch shove Gantu into the same closet that Sample is in, but Sample starts his rhythm again. Merwin and Dean try breaking in through the window, so Lilo leads everyone towards a different window to escape the house. Lilo, Stitch, and Sample head out the window, but Gantu gets stuck. The alien hunters get into the house, and pull Gantu back in through the window. The rest of the group sees this, and Stitch wants to leave him. But, Lilo insists they help him, not wanting to break her promise. The group goes back inside, but Gantu captures them all in a net. Gantu has apparently struck a deal with Merwin and Dean: they show Stitch and Sample to the convention's patrons, then they give Sample to Gantu. Lilo is forced to come along as well.

Later, at the convention center, Pleakley and Jumba arrive. Jumba worries that Pleakley will stick out like a sore thumb. But, once they enter, they see dozens of people dressed as aliens and sci-fi characters. Jumba takes off his wig, and the pair take in the sights. Meanwhile, on the main expo stage, Merwin and Dean show Stitch and Sample to an event coordinator. The coordinator thinks the experiments look like koalas, and brings up the ostrich incident. Merwin insists they are real, and the coordinator agrees to give them a turn on stage, if only because it will be funny. While they discuss this, Stitch escapes his container, then frees Sample.

Jumba and Pleakley continue to explore the convention, mistaking cosplayers for old friends and talking to "space explorers." They come across a live band, Fox Roswell and the Tall Greys, but their music is horrible. The sight-seeing is interrupted by the event coordinator making an announcement: Merwin and Dean will (again) show real aliens to the convention. While Merwin makes his intro speech, Gantu goes to get the experiment containers. But, he notices that Stitch and Sample are on the ceiling, trying to get away. He tries grabbing at them, and the noise alerts Merwin, who peeks backstage. Merwin immediately signals for the curtains to open, revealing Gantu to everyone. Gantu whispers to Merwin that they had a deal. Merwin responds that since Gantu let the experiments escape, he will take their place in the showcase. Gantu tries to protest, but Dean points his "plasma cannon" at him again. Merwin and Dean insult Gantu and force him to dance for the crowd. Pleakley starts to panic, but Jumba calms him down by saying the cannon is a fake, and Merwin and Dean aren't really hunters. Pleakley still worries that the other humans know Gantu is an alien, but the people in the crowd think Gantu is a Samoan guy in a whale suit.

Lilo approaches Jumba and Pleakley and asks if they want to watch Fox Roswell's band again, adding that they added a new "rhythm section." The group goes to see the band, which now includes Sample, keeping the beat with his sounds.

Shoe (episode).plot: When [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] ends up short on cash, the rest of the ''ʻohana'' decide to start a "[[Jumba & Pleakley's Bed & Not Breakfast|Bed and Not Breakfast]]" to bring in extra money. [[Shoe (113)|An experiment designed to bring bad luck]] threatens to ruin the business, until [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] remembers that its effects can be reversed to turn very bad luck into very good luck. When Shoe runs away after overhearing that he is useless because of his bad luck effects, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] must find Shoe before [[Gantu]] does.

Shortstuff (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] takes [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] to a carnival, but Stitch is too short to go on any of the rides. Meanwhile, [[Shortstuff (297)|a small crab-like experiment that fouls up machinery]] is activated. [[Pleakley]] uses [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]]'s [[Protoplasmic Growth Ray|invention]] without his permission to make Stitch grow, but [[Gantu]] interrupts and Stitch grows too big. Then, Shortstuff is also enlarged, and the two giants battle each other back at the carnival. Shortstuff is defeated after Stitch returns to normal size and becomes a new ride at the carnival, thanks to his giant size. Meanwhile, 625 seeks to eat the world's largest sandwich.

Shush (episode).plot: [[Shush (234)|An experiment designed to collect private enemy conversations through his tail]] is accidentally activated by [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], who then gets into trouble after eavesdropping on [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]]'s phone call with [[David Kawena|David]]. Things take a turn for the worst when Lilo overhears part of [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]]'s conversation and thinks that she hates her friends. As a result, Mertle, out of anger, willingly helps catch experiments for [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] in place of [[Gantu]], unaware that he is using her.

Sinker (episode).plot:
[[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] are at the beach with [[Keoni Jameson|Keoni]], who is practicing for the upcoming boat race. While feeding [[Pudge|Pudge the fish]] a peanut butter sandwich, Lilo spots a large purple dorsal fin luring in the waters. It rises to the surface and slices Keoni's boat in half, sinking it. After recalling what they saw to [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]], Jumba recognizes this incident to be the work of [[Sinker (602)|Experiment 602]]: Designed to sink ships by slicing them in half with its large dorsal fin. According to Jumba, 602 is very territorial and until he is captured any ship sailing in the bay will be sunk, including the ones participating in the boat race. Meanwhile, [[Gantu]] and [[Reuben (625)|625]] are already on the hunt for 602, but keep getting their boats sunk by the experiment. Jumba outfits the [[X-Buggy]] for aquatic travel. Stitch refuses to go because of his inability to float on water, but Jumba has designed some special life jackets for both him and Lilo encase any of them go overboard. Lilo and Stitch are soon out at sea, but as they prepare the capture cannon 602 sneaks up on them and sinks their buggy. Jumba and Pleakley row out to the rescue in an inflatable raft that they hijack from Gantu, which also gets sunk by 602, leaving all four of them stranded at sea.

Three minutes pass and Lilo, Stitch, Jumba, and Pleakley are still adrift at sea. 602, who Lilo has named "Sinker", has made no attack on them since he only sinks boats. So, for now they are safe. Just then, a cruise ship sails by but does not see Lilo, Stitch, Jumba and Pleakley. Stitch gets aboard and users the anchor to hoist Lilo, Jumba and Pleakley. Once aboard, Jumba and Pleakley go around the ship collecting parts to construct a device for capturing Sinker. Meanwhile, Lilo and Stitch go looking for the captain to warn him that his ship is in danger. However, Stitch causes a scene when he decides to check out the buffet. Lilo and Stitch get caught by a peppy cruise director named Tiffany, who takes them to the nursery. During nap time, Lilo and Stitch try to sneak out, leaving behind a decoy, but get caught again by Tiffany. She even catches Jumba and Pleakley hiding in a lifeboat, and has all four of them sent to the brig where they will remain until the ship drops them off at Hawaii. Little does the crew know that by going to Hawaii they will alert Sinker and he will sink the ship once it enters the bay.

Just when Lilo starts to feel hopeless, Jumba reveals that he has a plan to capture Sinker. After escaping from their cell, they return to the lifeboat Jumba and Pleakley were in and fitted Stitch with a custom-made diving suit, made from a blending machine, a radio, and a light bulb from one of the ship's deck lamps. Stitch jumps into the water and goes after Sinker, who turns out to be puny compared to his large dorsal fin. Meanwhile, Lilo, Jumba and Pleakley go looking for the captain, disguised as passengers to avoid getting caught again. When they find the bridge, Pleakley accidentally knocks the captain overboard. Pleakley tries to take control of the ship, but Jumba insists on steering the ship. Pretty soon, the two of them fight over the steering wheel until they break it, making it impossible to steer or stop the ship. When Stitch notices that they are in trouble, he gets back onto the ship and uses the anchor again to capture Sinker, wrapping him up in a ball of chains. Then he dives back into the and gets to the back of the ship to reverse the props. This causes the ship to slow down and end up beached on the shores right in front of Keoni, with Lilo jokingly telling Keoni that she found him a new boat.

After being sunk several times, Gantu and 625 end up stranded on a tiny island, which also sinks. As for Sinker, he has found his one true place as a sushi chef in a [[Japanese Restaurant|Japanese restaurant]].

Skip (episode).plot: Tired of childhood restrictions, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] uses [[Skip (089)|an experiment that skips time ahead ten years in the future]] to turn herself into a teenager and then into an adult. However, while she and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] disappear for twenty years, [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Dr. Hämsterviel]] captures all the experiments and takes over the galaxy.

Slick (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] compete with [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] to sell the most candy bars for their [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]], with the winner getting a year's supply of shave ice from [[Luki's Shave Ice]] stand. The competition turns fierce when [[Slick (020)|a fast-talking experiment that has the ability to sell anything]] appears and starts selling everything in plain sight, including himself through a live auction at one point. [[Gantu]] later kidnaps Slick, but gives him back to Lilo in exchange for a candy bar. Mertle wins the contest, but also gets very sick from eating too much shave ice.

Slugger (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]]'s baseball team loses to [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]]'s team due to [[Pleakley]]'s lack of confidence. Later, Lilo and Mertle make a bet for another game, and that whoever wins the game will get the other player's personal items. Then, [[Slugger (608)|a small yellow, pterosaur-like experiment that is designed to deflect projectiles with his baseball bat-shaped tail]] activates. Lilo decides to place Slugger on their team in Pleakley's place, in hopes of beating Mertle's team. But to make matters worse, Mertle has placed [[Gantu]] on her team, who has promised to help her win the game with a bargain to achieve Slugger in the end. Worse still, Mertle ends up changing things so they play basketball instead of baseball, but Pleakley saves the day as he turns out to be a champion player of a similar game on his [[Plorgonar|home world]].

Slushy (episode).plot: [[Slushy (523)|A freeze-inducing experiment]] is activated during a very hot day and chills the weather so much that it produces [[Kokaua Town]]'s very first snowfall. [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] soon capture Slushy and take him [[Lilo's House|home]], where he makes it snow for them to play and have fun. [[Gantu]] later kidnaps Slushy and forces him to create an impenetrable ice fortress. Slushy also engages in battle with [[Splodyhead (619)|Splodyhead]], who ends up winning and restores the tropical climate to the [[Kauai|island]]. Slushy is found a one true place creating [[Luki's Shave Ice|shave ice]] at the ice cream shop.

Snafu (episode).plot: When [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] are informed by [[Nosy (199)|Nosy]] that all the experiments captured by [[Gantu]] are imprisoned in [[Gantu's Ship|his ship]], the two plan a rescue mission to free them. However, they accidentally activate [[Snafu (120)|an experiment designed to destroy complex plans]]. As Lilo and Stitch form a rescue team regardless, [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]] try to understand what love is, and Gantu tries to use a recording of [[Angel (624)|Angel]]'s siren song to turn all the experiments evil again. Snafu, however, foils up this plan.

Snooty (episode).plot:
While [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], and [[Victoria]] are having fun taking zombie pictures, an [[Experiment Pods|experiment pod]] activates, unleashing a bat-like experiment on the island. By evening, the experiment finds its way to Victoria's and tries to attack her. Victoria believes its a vampire, and calls Lilo and Stitch for help, who arrive with their vampire hunting gear. Then [[Gantu]] shows up to capture the experiment, only then do Lilo and Stitch realize its not a vampire. However, Victoria still believes it is a vampire. Stitch fights off Gantu, but the experiment escapes.

At [[Lilo's House]], Lilo looks up the experiment on [[Jumba's Computer]] and finds a match: [[Snooty (277)|Experiment 277]], designed to mine and enrich Snootonium, a rare intergalactic energy source that becomes unstable and dangerous once enriched. Fortunately, there is no Snootonium on Earth. Lilo names it "Snooty" and sets out to capture it, redeem it, and find its one true place. Victoria, however, feels they should "slay" it. Lilo tries to convince Victoria that Snooty is not dangerous once redeemed, but Victoria remains skeptical.

The next day, out on the streets, Snooty appears and makes another attempt on Victoria, prompting her to hide in [[Officer Kahiko]]'s police car. During this assault, Stitch bravely challenges Snooty, only to be attacked and sucked dry by the experiment, leaving him weak and fatigued. Following this attack, Victoria vows to slay the experiment despite Lilo's protests. Lilo brings Stitch home, where [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] discovers he has been drained of all mucus. Stitch's body is 62.7% mucus, and Snooty's attack has left him temporarily dehydrated. Jumba has also discovered that mucus has a chemical composition similar to Snootonium. Thus, Snooty's programming draws him to individuals with large quantities, like Victoria's allergies, which explains why he keeps chasing her.

Meanwhile, Victoria is in a hardware store looking for items to slay Snooty with. She then notices Gantu and decides to team up with him to slay the experiment. Using Gantu's [[Manta Shuttle|shuttle]], the two track Snooty down to his cave in the Hawaiian mountains, where Gantu uses Victoria as bait to successfully draw Snooty out. Lilo soon arrives with [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] and is shocked to see Victoria consorting with Gantu. She claims that Gantu is helping her slay Snooty, but Lilo manages to convince Victoria of his treachery. Gantu blasts Snooty into a [[Net Cannon|net]], but the latter is then saved by Victoria and Lilo, who both fight Gantu for the experiment. After being free, Snooty rests contentedly in Victoria's arms. Victoria finally realizes Snooty is not a monster, and apologizes to Lilo for not trusting her. Lilo tells Victoria that she was kind of right about Snooty being a "snot vampire". After Snooty uses his mucus-sucking powers to clear Victoria's sinuses, she decides to keep him as a pet.

All the while, [[Reuben|625]] informs Gantu that [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] has cut the cable (aside from one channel: The Sandwich Channel) until Gantu catches Snooty. Eventually, Gantu finds out that 625 lied just so he could have the TV all to himself. In the end, they watch the Macki Macaw show together.

Spats (episode).plot:
The Proud Family comes to visit Hawaii and stay in the "[[Jumba & Pleakley's Bed & Not Breakfast|Bed & Not Breakfast]]" for their vacation. While [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]] give [[Oscar Proud|Oscar]], [[Trudy Proud|Trudy]], [[Suga Mama Proud|Suga Mama]], and [[BeBe & CeCe Proud|the twins]] a ride to [[Wizard Kelly]]'s wrestling match, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] decides to help [[Penny Proud|Penny]] with her school report and lets Penny get more acquainted with [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]].

In the meantime, a squirrel appears inside a window of the "hotel" and takes an interest in [[Spats (397)|Experiment 397]]'s pod. Mistaking the pod for a nut, the squirrel attempts to eat it, but is unable to. The squirrel then throws 397's pod into a bowl of bath bombs. Suga Mama, while soaking in a hot tub, reaches for 397's pod, mistaking it for a bath bomb. Suga Mama then drops the pod into the bathtub, activating 397 (named Spats). Upon activation, Spats zaps the squirrel and [[Puff]] (who was sleeping on a throw rug), causing both animals to brawl with each other. Spats then zaps BeBe and CeCe, causing the twins to clash with each other, followed by Oscar and Trudy Proud, who fight as well.

Lilo and Penny later notice Spats on the loose and decide to capture him before [[Gantu]] does. However, Lilo and Penny get zapped and start fighting with each other. Stitch tries to break up the girls' conflict, even spinning Penny like a top. But she stops and they continue arguing, Stitch grabs [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]]'s [[X-Buggy|dune buggy]], tosses Penny and Lilo in and then straps them in, squishing them together. Later that night, Stitch and the girls arrive at the [[Birds of Paradise Hotel]], where Wizard Kelly is hosting "Wizard Kelly's Smack-up Throw-Down: Hawaiian Style, Y'all".

As the girls keep arguing, Spats keeps zapping people, including the wrestlers, and Stitch tries to catch Spats. Meanwhile, Penny begins to sulk about her vacation and finds a way to dissolve Spats' effects, by counting to ten (which Trudy told everyone to earlier, when the Proud's luggage got lost). When she is about to go tell Lilo, one of the wrestlers flies out of the ring, missing Penny by two inches, followed by his shoe and Spats. Penny catches him and scolds him for his mischief. But, after seeing his cuteness, Penny becomes smitten by him.

Gantu then shows up and threatens to take him away from Penny. Suga Mama shows up to defend her granddaughter and the alien experiment. Spats zaps Suga Mama and Gantu and they take their argument into the ring. Meanwhile, Lilo, still under Spats' effects, is still angry and not talking to Penny. Then, Penny convinces her to count to ten to help her calm down and it works. Soon enough, everybody else does it and they are back to normal. The next day, Lilo and Stitch found Spats' one true place; it was with Wizard Kelly and his pro wrestlers.

Also, [[Mr. Cooper]], the reviewer who stayed in their "hotel", gave a terrible review. But things all changed when the girls and Stitch come in through the door. Penny managed to get her school article finished and titled it: "My Hawaiian Alien Adventure". The girls take the article it to the town Gazette, where it gets printed. Lilo said that it would bring in more guests and ones that want to look for aliens too, and all is well.

Spike (episode).plot:
Out in [[Kokaua Town]], an event featuring media personality, [[Dr. Gladys Okra]], is taking place. Dr. Okra is prepared to speak, but her assistant accidentally spills a water bottle meant for her onto the ground. The water spills out, landing on an experiment pod. [[Spike (319)|The experiment]] activates, and shoots his sharp quills at Dr. Okra and her assistant. After a moment, the two of them stumble onto the stage, speaking gibberish and flailing around. 

While that is happening, class at the [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]] finishes up for the day. Moses tells the girls before they leave about the upcoming "Ohana-Rama" family trivia contest. The grand prize is a new computer and encyclopedias on DVD. [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] wants to beat [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]], who brags about her intelligence and how her family wins the contest every year. Lilo states that her family can win, especially with the ultra-intelligent [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] with her. Mertle mocks Lilo, saying that if her dog is smarter than her, the rest of her family has no chance at winning. This makes Lilo feel less confident, but still determined to win, so she and Stitch head home to strategize.

At the [[Lilo's House|house]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] has made an "evil-liminator," to instantly make a bad experiment turn good. He shows [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] the machine, and tests it on [[Squeak (110)|Experiment 110]], who annoys his victims with non-stop chatter. But, the machine explodes, and 110 continues to chatter. Pleakley suggests another method to rehabilitate experiments based on Dr. Okra's TV show, involving hugging and talking about feelings. At that point, Lilo and Stitch come home and bring Jumba and Pleakley to the [[Museum of Natural History Kauai|museum]] for trivia training. Once there, Lilo explains that she won't be participating, and needs alien geniuses to make up for her "dopey, Earth girl" brain. But, while everyone is inspecting different exhibits for information, Experiment 319 arrives, terrorizing the people and shooting his quills. He even manages to hit Jumba. Stitch removes the ribs from a whale skeleton exhibit, and uses them to trap the experiment. But, Stitch neglected to restrain the experiment's tail, which pokes him with some quills. Stitch staggers over to Lilo and babbles.

Back at home, Jumba explains what 319, now named "Spike", does. His quills contain a venom that makes people 99% silly and 1% clever. He says that he isn't immune to Spike's quills, but he is so intelligent that even having only 1% of his brain function means he won't act silly like the rest of Spike's victims. While this is happening, Stitch gets himself caught in the curtains, then has trouble figuring out how the mirror works. Jumba states that Stitch will be back to normal in 48 hours. But, since the Ohana-Rama is the following day, Lilo takes Stitch out to try and make him smart again. Jumba then says he will rebuild the evil-liminator to make Spike good. But Pleakley intervenes, not wanting Spike to be blown up. He suggests using the Dr. Okra method.

Pleakley invites a group of experiments to the house, and starts a therapy group called Evil Attitude Re-modification & Wayward Anger Extraction (or "E.A.R.W.A.X.") to rehabilitate experiments. [[Fibber (032)|Fibber]] is there to ensure that everyone in the group is honest. Pleakley asks if anyone has anything to share. [[Nosy (199)|Nosy]] goes first, but just blurts some gossip about Pleakley. [[Bonnie (149)|Bonnie]] "shares" that she is bored and is too smart for therapy. Fibber buzzes at this, which makes her mad. Pleakley tries getting the group back on track, but [[Slushy (523)|Slushy]] throwing a snowball which accidentally hits [[Splodyhead (619)|Splodyhead]] causes the experiments to start a free-for-all, which accidentally releases Spike from his capsule, causing him to chase the other experiments around. Pleakley has had enough, saying that they should, and ''will'', start hugging and crying. Pleakley runs out of the room, and comes back in a suit of metal armor. He approaches Spike, reassuring that he isn't a monster, and scoops him up in a hug. Spike tries resisting, but eventually starts to cry and hug Pleakley back. The other experiments are touched by this and hug each other.

Meanwhile, Lilo does everything she can to make Stitch smart again, using flashcards, basic math, and even an Elvis CD. But this fails, so she, Jumba and Pleakley must compete without Stitch. Lilo doubts that she is smart enough to beat Mertle and her family.

The following evening, at the Ohana-Rama, Lilo, Jumba, and Pleakley are facing off against Mertle, [[Mrs. Edmonds|her mother]], and [[Stacy Edmonds|her aunt]]. Lilo is still doubtful of their chances. The first part of the final round does not go well, as Lilo and Jumba answer questions incorrectly, and the Edmonds family is in the lead. After Jumba has a meltdown after missing a question, Moses suggests everyone take a break. Lilo walks over to Stitch and Spike who are in the audience. She gripes about losing the contest, and Spike tries to hug her to cheer her up. Lilo refuses, because he is still harmful to touch despite him being good now. She suggest Spike hug Mertle instead, and Pleakley scolds her, saying that making Mertle dumber would be cheating. While that is happening, Stitch managed to get a CD stuck onto his nose. He manages to pull it free, sending the disc flying back behind the contest stage. He, Lilo, and Spike go after it. Before they can leave, they notice [[Teresa]] backstage, sitting with an open laptop. She is speaking into a microphone. Lilo checks in front of the stage, and sees there is an earpiece in Mertle's ear. Teresa has been giving Mertle the answers to the trivia questions. Lilo gets angry, but tells Spike to give Teresa a hug. He eagerly does so, pricking Teresa with his quills.

The contest continues on, and Moses asks Mertle a question on Newton's Third Law of Motion. Mertle pauses to wait for Teresa's answer, then says something silly. The audience laughs loudly while Moses says she is incorrect, then asks Lilo's team. Lilo answers correctly and Mertle seethes. The round continues with Lilo's team catching up. Moses then declares a lightning round; one member from each team answers questions as fast as they can. Mertle insists on doing it, despite her mother's protests. Lilo decides to do the lightning round for her family, more confident in herself now that Mertle can't cheat. Moses begins the lightning round, and both girls face off. Mertle gives silly answers, while Lilo answers everything correctly. The scores between the teams are tied, and Moses asks the final question: What is the Hawaiian word meaning "friendship?" Mertle admits that she doesn't know, and Lilo answers correctly: pilialoha. Lilo's team wins the contest, as well as the new computer and educational DVDs. Mertle storms out of the building, angry that she lost to Lilo. Spike notices her being upset, then goes to hug her, poking her with his quills and making her dumb.

Some time later, Pleakley is holding another E.A.R.W.A.X. session. When the experiments become too emotional, they go to hug the emotional support experiment, Spike, who is now wearing the suit of armor from earlier. Stitch is now back to normal, and asks Lilo where the new computer is. Lilo says she donated it to the community center, since her family is smart without it. Jumba smiles and says Lilo is almost as smart as he is.

Splodyhead (episode).plot: In order to catch [[Splodyhead (619)|a plasma-shooting experiment]], [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]], [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]], [[Gantu]] and [[Reuben (625)|Reuben]] travel to the island of [[wikipedia:Niihau|Niʻihau]]. After becoming stranded on the beach under the threat of being blasted by Splodyhead, the two opposing teams become one "tribe" and are forced to work together to survive. This initially doesn't go well as Gantu and Stitch both want to be the leader until Reuben nominates Lilo. Under Lilo's leadership, the group manages to disable Splodyhead's powers, causing him to flee, but he's captured when Gantu and Stitch team up together against him. Gantu gets the experiment, but when [[David Kawena|David]] and [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] show up to rescue Lilo, Stitch, Jumba and Pleakley, they only agree to help him and Reuben back to shore if he gives them the experiment, which he reluctantly does.

Spooky (episode).plot:
It is Halloween, and [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] shows up at the [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]] costume party dressed as a dead hula girl and wearing an axe headband. However, after scaring the party guests, she is sent back home by [[Moses Puloki|Moses]] to change into a more decent costume. He suggests that Lilo should return to the party as a princess just like [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]], [[Elena]], [[Teresa]], and [[Yuki]]. 

At [[Lilo's House|home]], [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] has some candy ready for trick or treaters, who do not often come to the house, because according to Lilo, "nobody goes to the weirdo's house". [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] and [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] are trying to figure out what kind of costumes to wear. Lilo asks Pleakley to make her a princess costume. While waiting, she meets up with [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] in their tower. They talk about being scared, though Stitch claims that he fears nothing. Lilo admits that she is afraid of broccoli, clowns and [[Haunted House|a creepy old abandoned house]] that is on a hill. However, she shows Stitch that whenever she gets scared she sings "[[Aloha ʻOe]]" to help her cope with the heebie-jeebies.

Meanwhile back at the party, A hissing shape shifting blob with green eyes shows up as a headless Lilo and then as a giant spider. It scares Mertle, Elena, Teresa, and Yuki, and then the entire party who all run away in fear. Lilo, now in a princess costume, returns to the party with Stitch, only for the two of them to find place totally trashed and deserted. While Stitch goes off to search the kitchen, Lilo finds Mertle, Elena, Teresa, and Yuki hiding under a table, terrified. While searching the fridge, Stitch comes face to face with the shape shifting blob which turns into water. Stitch becomes terrified and desperately tries to get to high ground. He almost drowns until the blob hears Lilo looking for him and flees. Lilo finds Stitch terrified frantically saying "hissing green eyes". Lilo is suspicious because Mertle, Elena, Teresa, and Yuki too said they saw something hissing with green eyes.

Lilo and Stitch return home to check [[Jumba's Computer|Jumba's computer]]. Stitch has become so terrified of what he saw that he starts boarding up the windows and rearranging the furniture to keep the monster out. Lilo finds a match to the description Stitch and the girls made. The hissing blob with green eyes is [[Spooky (300)|Experiment 300]]: designed to terrorize people by transforming itself into their worst fears. Lilo and Stitch go out to find 300, but with everyone dressed all scary it could be anyone. When Lilo and Stitch go out to find 300, the search backfired, mainly due to Stitch, who has been reduced into a mere coward as the result of the traumatic experience he had earlier from that point, starts capturing everyone, including Lilo, thinking that everyone in Halloween costumes are 300 transformed as them.

At some point, Experiment 300 shows up at Lilo's house as Nani's worst fear, [[Cobra Bubbles]] saying he is going to take Lilo away. When Lilo and Stitch return home from a failed search, Lilo quickly identifies Mr. Bubbles as Experiment 300 when he gives off a hiss. They rush in to capture him, but he escapes. Lilo, Stitch, Jumba, and Pleakley chase after Experiment 300, with Lilo now calling him "Spooky", to the old abandoned house that Lilo is afraid of. Despite both being very scared, Lilo and Stitch bravely enter the house while Lilo sings to herself "Aloha ʻOe". Spooky continues to terrify all four of them with their worst fears. Even Stitch is too scared, especially after falling into an abandoned swimming pool. However, by singing "Aloha ʻOe" to himself, he is able to overcome the heebie-jeebies. When Spooky notices that Stitch has faced his fears, and was thus undaunted by any other scary transformations, the former turns into a bat to escape, but is ambushed and captured.

Afterwards, Spooky finds his one true place, scaring trick-or-treaters on Halloween and haunting the old abandoned house.

Sprout (episode).plot:
While mailing a letter to her pen pal Henry, [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] finds an [[Experiment Pods|experiment pod]] on the floor in the post office, numbered [[Sprout (509)|509]]. According to [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]], Experiment 509 is an agriculture experiment: designed to be an uncontrollable forest of destruction. Lilo is keen to activate it and make friends with it, but Jumba locks the pod away in a drawer, saying this Experiment is far too dangerous to risk activating.

At the [[Kaiāulu Hale]], Lilo finds out that [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] is entering an orchid in the upcoming [[Kokaua Town]] Fair, and makes a bet with her. Meanwhile, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] practices being a cowboy for the Kokaua Town Fair rodeo, and [[Pleakley]] plans to enter his giant "Pinormous" pineapple in the fruits and vegetables' competition. Because an orchid takes a long time to grow, and the fair is on the following day, Lilo decides to enter Experiment 509 in the competition. With Stitch's help, she steals 509's pod from Jumba's drawer and activates it.

The next day, Lilo, Stitch, and Pleakley arrive at the town fair with Pleakley's Pinormous and 509, who Lilo has named "Sprout". Stitch also meets his competition in the rodeo, five time champion [[Zach Makeli]]. Lilo leaves Sprout on display with the other orchids entering the competition, and the accompanies Stitch to the rodeo. When Mertle approaches Sprout and notices he is not an orchid, Sprout lashes out at her, causing Mertle to accidentally break his pot open. Free from his containment, Sprout roots into the ground and grows into a massive forest of killer plants, which take over the Kokaua Town Fair.

In their struggle against the monstrous forests of Sprouts, Lilo and Stitch get to high ground at the top of the [[Pineapple Water Tower|pineapple water tower]]. Here, Lilo feels very ashamed of herself, as this was all her fault. Jumba warned her that 509 was too dangerous to activate, but she ignored him and let her desire to beat Mertle influence her decisions. Meanwhile, Nani and Jumba are watching the events on TV and are furious with Lilo for her recklessness. Just then, they spot the original Sprout, who was now a giant. Lilo deduces that all the other Sprouts must have spread from the original. Remembering what Pleakley said the other day, this gives Lilo and Stitch the idea to contain Sprout's roots so he will not be able to spread. Since he is now ginormous, they decide to use the water tower as container. Stitch then heads down and races through the forest of Sprouts on a giant mower, shredding them in his path. Eventually, and with some help from Zach Makeli, Stitch manages to lasso the original Sprout, uproot him, and drag him into the water tower slated for demolition, trapping the latter and causing the forest to die off without the original Sprout. Lilo is unsure if this is Sprout's one true place, but it is the best she and Stitch could do on such short notice.

By sunset, the judges of the orchid competition reward Lilo with the blue ribbon, but decides to give it away to Mertle. Lilo has learned that a true champion either wins fair and square or loses fair and square. Nani then shows up and asks Lilo if she's alright. Lilo tells her she's okay and asks if she's grounded. Nani decides to ground her for a week (instead of a month), but promises her, she'll help her get a great plant for next year that will really beat Mertle.

Swapper (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] meets a new friend named [[Victoria]] who also joins Lilo's [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula class]]. However, [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] will stop at nothing to try and befriend her so that she will not be Lilo's friend. Lilo then attempts to prove that she's normal by throwing a "Lilo's Not Weird" party. However, [[Swapper (355)|an experiment that switches people's minds]] appears, resulting in Lilo, [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]], [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]] swapping bodies. From Stitch's body, Lilo must make sure the party is successful while Stitch has to pretend to be her, but nothing goes as planned, especially when [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] (who has switched bodies with [[Gantu]]) arrives. Eventually, Swapper is defeated and saved from Hämsterviel, and Victoria reveals that she enjoyed the party, likes weird and becomes Lilo's new best friend (and first human friend).

Swirly (episode).plot: A popular television show called ''Look at This!'' comes to Hawaii as [[Swirly (383)|a hypnotizing experiment]] is activated. [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] hate the show, but Lilo falls under Swirly's spell and is instructed to be more like [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]], who happens to love the show. Stitch also falls under Swirly's spell and is instructed to love the show. [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] orders [[Gantu]] to go on the show and use the experiment to hypnotize the viewers, thus bringing them under Hämsterviel's power. [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] frees Lilo and Stitch from the hypnosis and they rescue Swirly just in time and leave Gantu stranded in front of a live audience. Stitch later throws a party he won from the show, and Mertle is hypnotized by Swirly into thinking she's a chicken.

Tank (episode).plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] wins tickets to the Elizabethan Fair and invites [[Elena]], [[Teresa]] and [[Yuki]] to join her. However, [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] refuses to go because she does not want to be with Lilo, and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] is not allowed inside because no dogs are admitted. They team up to catch [[Tank (586)|a metal-eating experiment]] on a rampage. Eventually, [[Gantu]] is allowed to capture Tank in order to save Mertle and Stitch. The hula girls take Mertle back, and Lilo apologizes to Stitch for neglecting him.

The Asteroid.plot: [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] and [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] visit a planetarium and overhear [[Cobra Bubbles|Cobra]]'s warning of an asteroid that will impact Earth. With no one believing them or bothering to seek shelter, Stitch formulates a plan to go into outer space and destroy it to save the planet. However, when they discover that the asteroid itself is home to an alien, Lilo and Stitch must decide which home they must sacrifice for the sake of the other. In the end, the group uses [[Jumba's Ship|Jumba's ship]]'s hyperdrive to safely push the asteroid away from Earth without destroying it, but leaving [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] permanently stranded on Earth. Meanwhile, Lilo and Stitch become honorary agents.

Toddler-fier.plot: [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]] has transmutated [[Babyfier (151)|Experiment 151]] (also known as Babyfier) into "Toddler-fier" so he could transform Stitch into a toddler, but [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] avoids this and instead Babyfier zaps [[Yuna Kamihara|Yuna]], [[Jessica]], [[Dolores]], [[Toriko]], [[Makiko]], and [[Hiroman]]. Stitch spots and captures him. But Stitch has no idea how to cure the toddlers, so he brings the toddlers to [[Tigerlily]]. But Tigerlily is more interested in her date, and [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Pleakley]] went to go see a musical about kittens on skates. Tigerlily walks off to leave the problem to Stitch but Yuna accidentally splashes ketchup on her angering her mostly because it was very expensive. She wears another shirt and Stitch carries the kids in a baby cart, but they want to get out. The Toddlers come out and run in the street. They almost get hit by a car until Stitch saves them. Hämsterviel comes up with a new plan and instead decides to kidnap one of the toddlers and use them as bait to lure Stitch. Later, Stitch gives up babysitting but Tigerlily says he took on alien experiments, Hämsterviel, and mutants and won, and Tigerlily refuses to bring them on her date. Yuna and Jessica are arguing and Jessica near hurts herself until Stitch saved them. Now the kids are hungry, Tigerlily gives Stitch a $20 to buy sandwiches, but Jessica begins to act and tries to give Tigerlily bad publicity by accusing her of leaving her kids out in the open, Tigerlily complies and uses her salon money to buy the kids food, Jessica says that everybody makes sacrifices and despite not being her kids they say it's parenting. Tigerlily agrees to watch them but until her appointment which upsets Stitch, so they try tuckering them out which doesn't work. Tigerlily leaves to get her hair done, but Jessica gets kidnapped. Stitch leaves the kids with Tigerlily, and he goes to save them. Stitch tries to get to Jessica, but he has to trade himself for him. Tigerlily using her skills managed to set Stitch free and with the help of the kids managed to overpower [[Gantu]]. With her suit messed up Tigerlily is unable to go on her date, but the kids convince her otherwise. Tigerlily shows up and unfortunately the kids have to and the date didn't go well Delia is ready to punish Hämsterviel but Hämsterviel (to avoid punishment) dresses up as a baby, Delia tells him to man up and he is doing an obstacle course. Tigerlily is upset because she blew it, but Hiroman and Jessica tells her the guy probably didn't like you because she had kids.

Topper (episode).plot: It is Christmas Eve, and [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] is trying to teach [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] how Hawaiians celebrate Christmas, but Stitch becomes overly obsessed with the Christmas gifts. [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] and [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] attempt to get into the Christmas spirit as well. However, when [[Gantu]] has [[Topper (025)|an experiment pod]] giftwrapped for [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Hämsterviel]], everyone mistakes Stitch's hunt for the box as a selfish attempt to hoard presents for himself.

Wishy-Washy (episode).plot: It is nearly graduation for [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]], and everyone needs to have a photograph with their parents, but [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] currently has no [[Mr. and Mrs. Pelekai|parents]]. Along comes [[Wishy-Washy (267)|an experiment designed to makes wishes]], so Lilo decides to try to get [[Nani Pelekai|Nani]] and [[David Kawena|David]] married by turning David into a genius, which only irritates Nani. Now, Lilo must get David back to normal before [[Gantu]] uses up all of Wishy-Washy's wishes to take over the world.

Woops (episode).plot: [[Woops (600)|A clumsy experiment]] causes [[Jacques von Hämsterviel|Dr. Hämsterviel]] to nearly be caught by his [[UGF Troopers|prison guards]], so he returns all the captured experiments to [[Gantu]] for safekeeping. However, when Gantu eventually lets the troublemaking experiment go, Woops threatens to ruin [[Pleakley]]'s chance at a domino championship.

Yaarp (episode).plot:
Newlyweds [[Charles and Mary]] are exploring [[Kokaua Town]] on their honeymoon. They arrive at [[Mrs. Hasagawa]]'s [[Hasagawa Fruits|fruit stand]]. While Mrs. Hasagawa waters the fruit, Mary asks for some passionfruit to buy. Mrs. Hasagawa sets down the still-running hose inside the crate of pineapples, which activates an experiment pod that was nestled inside. [[Yaarp (613)|The experiment]] appears, and Charles thinks its a type of sheep. He offers it some fruit, and in response, 613 uncurls his horn and blasts a loud honk at Charles and Mary, sending them flying and destroying the bus behind them, before hopping away on his tail. 

Meanwhile, at the [[Kaiāulu Hale|hula school]], the girls are presenting ideas on how to improve the school. [[Mertle Edmonds|Mertle]] pitches "Mertle's Mural" on one of the walls. [[Lilo Pelekai|Lilo]] then presents her idea for an alien invasion alarm, with [[Stitch (626)|Stitch]] providing visual aids. Ultimately, [[Moses Puloki|Moses]] chooses Mertle's mural as the improvement project, and schedules the start date for that Saturday. Lilo is disappointed so Moses suggests she write a letter to the [[Mayor Anolo|mayor]] about her alarm idea. Lilo doubts it will help since she is little. Moses suggest she tries anyway, since small people can have big voices, too.

Later at home, [[Wendy Pleakley|Pleakley]] is putting the finishing touches on a delicate souffle and [[Jumba Jookiba|Jumba]] is about to go leave to go fishing, when a loud horn is heard, causing a tremor. Stitch uses his powerful hearing to determine what is going on, and hears [[Gantu]]'s voice after the horns. Stitch drags the moping Lilo into town to find the loose experiment. The experiment has made his way to an electronics store, using his sonic blasts to destroy everything. Gantu follows with noise-dampening earmuffs and manages to catch the experiment in a capsule. Lilo and Stitch arrive, and Stitch grabs the capsule. He runs off with it, then throws a giant TV at Gantu, slowing him down.
